verses.translit: kai euren en to iero tous polountas voas kai provata kai peristeras kai tous kermatistas kathimenoys,
verses.translation: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

verses.original: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων πάντας ἐξέβαλεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τά τε πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας, καὶ τῶν κολλυβιστῶν ἐξέχεεν ⸂τὰ κέρματα⸃ καὶ τὰς τραπέζας ⸀ἀνέστρεψεν,
verses.translit: kai poiisas fragellion ek shoinion pantas exevalen ek tou ierou ta te provata kai tous voas, kai ton kollyviston exeheen ta kermata kai tas trapezas anestrepsen,
verses.translation: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

verses.original: καὶ τοῖς τὰς περιστερὰς πωλοῦσιν εἶπεν· Ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν, μὴ ποιεῖτε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου οἶκον ἐμπορίου.
verses.translit: kai tois tas peristeras polousin eipen* Arate tauta enteuthen, me poieite ton oikon tou patros moy oikon emporioy.
verses.translation: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

verses.original: ⸀ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν· Ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με.
verses.translit: emnisthisan oi mathitai autou oti gegrammenon estin* O zelos tou oikoy soy katafagetai me.
verses.translation: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν, ὅτι ταῦτα ποιεῖς;
verses.translit: apekrithisan oun oi Ioydaioi kai eipan auto* Ti simeion deiknyeis emin, oti tauta poieis;
verses.translation: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen autois* Lysate ton naon touton kai en trisin emerais egero auton.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

verses.original: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη ὁ ναὸς οὗτος, καὶ σὺ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν;
verses.translit: eipan oun oi Ioydaioi* Tesserakonta kai ex etesin oikodomithi o naos outos, kai su en trisin emerais egereis auton;
verses.translation: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

verses.original: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ekeinos de elegen peri tou naou tou somatos autou.
verses.translation: But he spake of the temple of his body.

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἔλεγεν, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ⸀ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.
verses.translit: ote oun egerthi ek nekron, emnisthisan oi mathitai autou oti touto elegen, kai episteysan te grafe kai to logo on eipen o Iisous.
verses.translation: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει·
verses.translit: Os de en en tois Ierosolymois en to pasha en te eorte, polloi episteysan eis to onoma autou, theorountes autou ta simeia a epoiei*
verses.translation: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day , many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

verses.original: αὐτὸς ⸀δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν ⸀αὑτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν γινώσκειν πάντας
verses.translit: autos de Iisous ouk episteyen auton autois dia to auton ginoskein pantas
verses.translation: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men ,

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι οὐ χρείαν εἶχεν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, αὐτὸς γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ.
verses.translit: kai oti ou hreian eihen ina tis martyrise peri tou anthropoy, autos gar eginosken ti en en to anthropo.
verses.translation: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων, Νικόδημος ὄνομα αὐτῷ, ἄρχων τῶν Ἰουδαίων·
verses.translit: En de anthropos ek ton Farisaion, Nikodimos onoma auto, arhon ton Ioydaion*
verses.translation: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

verses.original: οὗτος ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ῥαββί, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐλήλυθας διδάσκαλος· οὐδεὶς γὰρ ⸂δύναται ταῦτα τὰ σημεῖα⸃ ποιεῖν ἃ σὺ ποιεῖς, ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ ὁ θεὸς μετʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: outos elthen pros auton nyktos kai eipen auto* Ravvi, oidamen oti apo theou elilythas didaskalos* oudeis gar dynatai tauta ta simeia poiein a su poieis, ean me e o theos met' autou.
verses.translation: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

verses.original: ⸀ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἄνωθεν, οὐ δύναται ἰδεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen auto* Amen amen lego soi, ean mi tis gennithe anothen, ou dynatai idein ten vasileian tou theou.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

verses.original: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ⸀ὁ Νικόδημος· Πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος γεννηθῆναι γέρων ὤν; μὴ δύναται εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ δεύτερον εἰσελθεῖν καὶ γεννηθῆναι;
verses.translit: legei pros auton o Nikodimos* Pos dynatai anthropos gennithenai geron on; me dynatai eis ten koilian tes mitros autou deyteron eiselthein kai gennithenai;
verses.translation: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

verses.original: ⸀ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ πνεύματος, οὐ δύναται εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous* Amen amen lego soi, ean mi tis gennithe ex udatos kai pneymatos, ou dynatai eiselthein eis ten vasileian tou theou.
verses.translation: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.original: τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς σάρξ ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος πνεῦμά ἐστιν.
verses.translit: to gegennimenon ek tes sarkos sarx estin, kai to gegennimenon ek tou pneymatos pneuma estin.
verses.translation: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.original: μὴ θαυμάσῃς ὅτι εἶπόν σοι Δεῖ ὑμᾶς γεννηθῆναι ἄνωθεν.
verses.translit: me thaymases oti eipon soi Dei umas gennithenai anothen.
verses.translation: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμα ὅπου θέλει πνεῖ, καὶ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἀκούεις, ἀλλʼ οὐκ οἶδας πόθεν ἔρχεται καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγει· οὕτως ἐστὶν πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος.
verses.translit: to pneuma opoy thelei pnei, kai ten fonen autou akoyeis, all' ouk oidas pothen erhetai kai pou upagei* outos estin pas o gegennimenos ek tou pneymatos.
verses.translation: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Νικόδημος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Πῶς δύναται ταῦτα γενέσθαι;
verses.translit: apekrithi Nikodimos kai eipen auto* Pos dynatai tauta genesthai;
verses.translation: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Σὺ εἶ ὁ διδάσκαλος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ταῦτα οὐ γινώσκεις;
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen auto* Su ei o didaskalos tou Israel kai tauta ou ginoskeis;
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ὃ οἴδαμεν λαλοῦμεν καὶ ὃ ἑωράκαμεν μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἡμῶν οὐ λαμβάνετε.
verses.translit: amen amen lego soi oti o oidamen laloumen kai o eorakamen martyroumen, kai ten martyrian emon ou lamvanete.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

verses.original: εἰ τὰ ἐπίγεια εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς ἐὰν εἴπω ὑμῖν τὰ ἐπουράνια πιστεύσετε;
verses.translit: ei ta epigeia eipon umin kai ou pisteyete, pos ean eipo umin ta epoyrania pisteysete;
verses.translation: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

verses.original: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀναβέβηκεν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ⸀ἀνθρώπου.
verses.translit: kai oudeis anaveviken eis ton ouranon ei me o ek tou ouranou katavas, o yios tou anthropoy.
verses.translation: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

verses.original: καὶ καθὼς Μωϋσῆς ὕψωσεν τὸν ὄφιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οὕτως ὑψωθῆναι δεῖ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου,
verses.translit: kai kathos Moyses upsosen ton ofin en te erimo, outos upsothenai dei ton yion tou anthropoy,
verses.translation: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

verses.original: ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ⸂ἐν αὐτῷ⸃ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: ina pas o pisteyon en auto ehe zoen aionion.
verses.translation: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.original: Οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον ὥστε τὸν ⸀υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλὰ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: Outos gar egapisen o theos ton kosmon oste ton yion ton monogene edoken, ina pas o pisteyon eis auton me apolitai alla ehe zoen aionion.
verses.translation: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν ⸀υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλʼ ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος διʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ou gar apesteilen o theos ton yion eis ton kosmon ina krine ton kosmon, all' ina sothe o kosmos di' autou.
verses.translation: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν οὐ κρίνεται· ὁ ⸀δὲ μὴ πιστεύων ἤδη κέκριται, ὅτι μὴ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ μονογενοῦς υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: o pisteyon eis auton ou krinetai* o de me pisteyon edi kekritai, oti me pepisteyken eis to onoma tou monogenous yiou tou theou.
verses.translation: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

verses.original: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ κρίσις ὅτι τὸ φῶς ἐλήλυθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον καὶ ἠγάπησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι μᾶλλον τὸ σκότος ἢ τὸ φῶς, ἦν γὰρ ⸂αὐτῶν πονηρὰ⸃ τὰ ἔργα.
verses.translit: auti de estin e krisis oti to fos elilythen eis ton kosmon kai egapisan oi anthropoi mallon to skotos e to fos, en gar auton ponira ta erga.
verses.translation: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ φαῦλα πράσσων μισεῖ τὸ φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα μὴ ἐλεγχθῇ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: pas gar o faula prasson misei to fos kai ouk erhetai pros to fos, ina me eleghthe ta erga autou*
verses.translation: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα φανερωθῇ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ὅτι ἐν θεῷ ἐστιν εἰργασμένα.
verses.translit: o de poion ten alitheian erhetai pros to fos, ina fanerothe autou ta erga oti en theo estin eirgasmena.
verses.translation: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν γῆν, καὶ ἐκεῖ διέτριβεν μετʼ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβάπτιζεν.
verses.translit: Meta tauta elthen o Iisous kai oi mathitai autou eis ten Ioydaian gen, kai ekei dietriven met' auton kai evaptizen.
verses.translation: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ καὶ ⸀ὁ Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων ἐν Αἰνὼν ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ, ὅτι ὕδατα πολλὰ ἦν ἐκεῖ, καὶ παρεγίνοντο καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο·
verses.translit: en de kai o Ioannis vaptizon en Ainon eggus tou Saleim, oti udata polla en ekei, kai pareginonto kai evaptizonto*
verses.translation: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

verses.original: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν βεβλημένος εἰς τὴν φυλακὴν ⸀ὁ Ἰωάννης.
verses.translit: oupo gar en vevlimenos eis ten fylaken o Ioannis.
verses.translation: For John was not yet cast into prison.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο οὖν ζήτησις ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν Ἰωάννου μετὰ Ἰουδαίου περὶ καθαρισμοῦ.
verses.translit: Egeneto oun zitisis ek ton mathiton Ioannoy meta Ioydaioy peri katharismou.
verses.translation: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ῥαββί, ὃς ἦν μετὰ σοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ᾧ σὺ μεμαρτύρηκας, ἴδε οὗτος βαπτίζει καὶ πάντες ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai elthon pros ton Ioannin kai eipan auto* Ravvi, os en meta sou peran tou Iordanoy, o su memartyrikas, ide outos vaptizei kai pantes erhontai pros auton.
verses.translation: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰωάννης καὶ εἶπεν· Οὐ δύναται ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνειν ⸂οὐδὲ ἓν⸃ ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
verses.translit: apekrithi Ioannis kai eipen* Ou dynatai anthropos lamvanein oude en ean me e dedomenon auto ek tou ouranou.
verses.translation: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς ⸀μοι μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι ⸀εἶπον· Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ χριστός, ἀλλʼ ὅτι Ἀπεσταλμένος εἰμὶ ἔμπροσθεν ἐκείνου.
verses.translit: autoi umeis moi martyreite oti eipon* Ouk eimi ego o hristos, all' oti Apestalmenos eimi emprosthen ekeinoy.
verses.translation: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων τὴν νύμφην νυμφίος ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου ὁ ἑστηκὼς καὶ ἀκούων αὐτοῦ, χαρᾷ χαίρει διὰ τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ νυμφίου. αὕτη οὖν ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ πεπλήρωται.
verses.translit: o ehon ten nymfin nymfios estin* o de filos tou nymfioy o estikos kai akoyon autou, hara hairei dia ten fonen tou nymfioy. auti oun e hara e eme peplirotai.
verses.translation: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνον δεῖ αὐξάνειν, ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι.
verses.translit: ekeinon dei auxanein, eme de elattousthai.
verses.translation: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.original: Ὁ ἄνωθεν ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν. ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς λαλεῖ· ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν·
verses.translit: O anothen erhomenos epano panton estin. o on ek tes ges ek tes ges estin kai ek tes ges lalei* o ek tou ouranou erhomenos epano panton estin*
verses.translation: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

verses.original: ⸀ὃ ἑώρακεν καὶ ἤκουσεν τοῦτο μαρτυρεῖ, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτοῦ οὐδεὶς λαμβάνει.
verses.translit: o eoraken kai ekoysen touto martyrei, kai ten martyrian autou oudeis lamvanei.
verses.translation: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

verses.original: ὁ λαβὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐσφράγισεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀληθής ἐστιν.
verses.translit: o lavon autou ten martyrian esfragisen oti o theos alithis estin.
verses.translation: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

verses.original: ὃν γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ λαλεῖ, οὐ γὰρ ἐκ μέτρου ⸀δίδωσιν τὸ πνεῦμα.
verses.translit: on gar apesteilen o theos ta Rimata tou theou lalei, ou gar ek metroy didosin to pneuma.
verses.translation: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .

verses.original: ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν υἱόν, καὶ πάντα δέδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o pater agapa ton yion, kai panta dedoken en te heiri autou.
verses.translation: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον· ὁ δὲ ἀπειθῶν τῷ υἱῷ οὐκ ὄψεται ζωήν, ἀλλʼ ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
verses.translit: o pisteyon eis ton yion ehei zoen aionion* o de apeithon to yio ouk opsetai zoin, all' e orge tou theou menei ep' auton.
verses.translation: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

verses.original: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ ⸀Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὅτι Ἰησοῦς πλείονας μαθητὰς ποιεῖ καὶ βαπτίζει ἢ Ἰωάννης—
verses.translit: Os oun egno o Iisous oti ekoysan oi Farisaioi oti Iisous pleionas mathitas poiei kai vaptizei e Ioannis--
verses.translation: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

verses.original: καίτοιγε Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐβάπτιζεν ἀλλʼ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ—
verses.translit: kaitoige Iisous autos ouk evaptizen all' oi mathitai autou--
verses.translation: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

verses.original: ἀφῆκεν τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ⸀πάλιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.translit: afeken ten Ioydaian kai apelthen palin eis ten Galilaian.
verses.translation: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.

verses.original: ἔδει δὲ αὐτὸν διέρχεσθαι διὰ τῆς Σαμαρείας.
verses.translit: edei de auton dierhesthai dia tes Samareias.
verses.translation: And he must needs go through Samaria.

verses.original: ἔρχεται οὖν εἰς πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρείας λεγομένην Συχὰρ πλησίον τοῦ χωρίου ὃ ἔδωκεν Ἰακὼβ ⸀τῷ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: erhetai oun eis polin tes Samareias legomenin Syhar plision tou horioy o edoken Iakov to Iosef to yio autou*
verses.translation: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πηγὴ τοῦ Ἰακώβ. ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς κεκοπιακὼς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοιπορίας ἐκαθέζετο οὕτως ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ· ὥρα ἦν ⸀ὡς ἕκτη.
verses.translit: en de ekei pige tou Iakov. o oun Iisous kekopiakos ek tes odoiporias ekathezeto outos epi te pige* ora en os ekti.
verses.translation: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

verses.original: Ἔρχεται γυνὴ ἐκ τῆς Σαμαρείας ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Δός μοι πεῖν·
verses.translit: Erhetai gyne ek tes Samareias antlesai udor. legei aute o Iisous* Dos moi pein*
verses.translation: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπεληλύθεισαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, ἵνα τροφὰς ἀγοράσωσιν.
verses.translit: oi gar mathitai autou apelilytheisan eis ten polin, ina trofas agorasosin.
verses.translation: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

verses.original: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ Σαμαρῖτις· Πῶς σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὢν παρʼ ἐμοῦ πεῖν αἰτεῖς ⸂γυναικὸς Σαμαρίτιδος οὔσης⸃; οὐ γὰρ συγχρῶνται Ἰουδαῖοι Σαμαρίταις.
verses.translit: legei oun auto e gyne e Samaritis* Pos su Ioydaios on par' emou pein aiteis gynaikos Samaritidos ousis; ou gar syghrontai Ioydaioi Samaritais.
verses.translation: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Εἰ ᾔδεις τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ λέγων σοι· Δός μοι πεῖν, σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄν σοι ὕδωρ ζῶν.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen aute* Ei edeis ten dorean tou theou kai tis estin o legon soi* Dos moi pein, su an etisas auton kai edoken an soi udor zon.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸂ἡ γυνή⸃· Κύριε, οὔτε ἄντλημα ἔχεις καὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἐστὶν βαθύ· πόθεν οὖν ἔχεις τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ζῶν;
verses.translit: legei auto e gyni* Kyrie, oute antlima eheis kai to frear estin vathy* pothen oun eheis to udor to zon;
verses.translation: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

verses.original: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰακώβ, ὃς ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὸ φρέαρ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔπιεν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θρέμματα αὐτοῦ;
verses.translit: me su meizon ei tou patros emon Iakov, os edoken emin to frear kai autos ex autou epien kai oi yioi autou kai ta thremmata autou;
verses.translation: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν·
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen aute* Pas o pinon ek tou udatos toytoy dipsisei palin*
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

verses.original: ὃς δʼ ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ ⸀διψήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ δώσω αὐτῷ γενήσεται ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴ ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: os d' an pie ek tou udatos ou ego doso auto, ou me dipsisei eis ton aiona, alla to udor o doso auto genisetai en auto pige udatos allomenoy eis zoen aionion.
verses.translation: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.original: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνή· Κύριε, δός μοι τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ, ἵνα μὴ διψῶ μηδὲ ⸀διέρχωμαι ἐνθάδε ἀντλεῖν.
verses.translit: legei pros auton e gyni* Kyrie, dos moi touto to udor, ina me dipso mide dierhomai enthade antlein.
verses.translation: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

verses.original: Λέγει ⸀αὐτῇ· Ὕπαγε φώνησον ⸂τὸν ἄνδρα σου⸃ καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε.
verses.translit: Legei aute* Upage fonison ton andra soy kai elthe enthade.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν ⸀αὐτῷ· Οὐκ ἔχω ἄνδρα. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Καλῶς εἶπας ὅτι Ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω·
verses.translit: apekrithi e gyne kai eipen auto* Ouk eho andra. legei aute o Iisous* Kalos eipas oti Andra ouk eho*
verses.translation: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

verses.original: πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες, καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ· τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας.
verses.translit: pente gar andras eshes, kai nun on eheis ouk estin soy anir* touto alithes eirikas.
verses.translation: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή· Κύριε, θεωρῶ ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σύ.
verses.translit: legei auto e gyni* Kyrie, theoro oti profitis ei sy.
verses.translation: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ προσεκύνησαν· καὶ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐστὶν ὁ τόπος ὅπου ⸂προσκυνεῖν δεῖ⸃.
verses.translit: oi pateres emon en to orei toyto prosekynisan* kai umeis legete oti en Ierosolymois estin o topos opoy proskynein dei.
verses.translation: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ⸂Πίστευέ μοι, γύναι⸃, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὔτε ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ οὔτε ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις προσκυνήσετε τῷ πατρί.
verses.translit: legei aute o Iisous* Pisteye moi, gynai, oti erhetai ora ote oute en to orei toyto oute en Ierosolymois proskynisete to patri.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς προσκυνεῖτε ὃ οὐκ οἴδατε, ἡμεῖς προσκυνοῦμεν ὃ οἴδαμεν, ὅτι ἡ σωτηρία ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐστίν·
verses.translit: umeis proskyneite o ouk oidate, emeis proskynoumen o oidamen, oti e sotiria ek ton Ioydaion estin*
verses.translation: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν, ὅτε οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ πατρὶ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ τοιούτους ζητεῖ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτόν·
verses.translit: alla erhetai ora kai nun estin, ote oi alithinoi proskynitai proskynisoysin to patri en pneymati kai alitheia, kai gar o pater toioytoys zitei tous proskynountas auton*
verses.translation: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

verses.original: πνεῦμα ὁ θεός, καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτὸν ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν.
verses.translit: pneuma o theos, kai tous proskynountas auton en pneymati kai alitheia dei proskynein.
verses.translation: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή· Οἶδα ὅτι Μεσσίας ἔρχεται, ὁ λεγόμενος χριστός· ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν ⸀ἅπαντα.
verses.translit: legei auto e gyni* Oida oti Messias erhetai, o legomenos hristos* otan elthe ekeinos, anaggelei emin apanta.
verses.translation: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι, ὁ λαλῶν σοι.
verses.translit: legei aute o Iisous* Ego eimi, o lalon soi.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἦλθαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ⸀ἐθαύμαζον ὅτι μετὰ γυναικὸς ἐλάλει· οὐδεὶς μέντοι εἶπεν· Τί ζητεῖς; ἢ τί λαλεῖς μετʼ αὐτῆς;
verses.translit: Kai epi toyto elthan oi mathitai autou, kai ethaymazon oti meta gynaikos elalei* oudeis mentoi eipen* Ti ziteis? e ti laleis met' autes;
verses.translation: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

verses.original: ἀφῆκεν οὖν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις·
verses.translit: afeken oun ten udrian autes e gyne kai apelthen eis ten polin kai legei tois anthropois*
verses.translation: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

verses.original: Δεῦτε ἴδετε ἄνθρωπον ὃς εἶπέ μοι πάντα ⸀ὅσα ἐποίησα· μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός;
verses.translit: Deute idete anthropon os eipe moi panta osa epoiisa* miti outos estin o hristos;
verses.translation: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν.
verses.translit: exelthon ek tes poleos kai erhonto pros auton.
verses.translation: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

verses.original: ⸀Ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες· Ῥαββί, φάγε.
verses.translit: En to metaxu eroton auton oi mathitai legontes* Ravvi, fage.
verses.translation: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ βρῶσιν ἔχω φαγεῖν ἣν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε.
verses.translit: o de eipen autois* Ego vrosin eho fagein en umeis ouk oidate.
verses.translation: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Μή τις ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν;
verses.translit: elegon oun oi mathitai pros alliloys* Mi tis enegken auto fagein;
verses.translation: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

verses.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐμὸν βρῶμά ἐστιν ἵνα ⸀ποιήσω τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με καὶ τελειώσω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔργον.
verses.translit: legei autois o Iisous* Emon vroma estin ina poiiso to thelima tou pempsantos me kai teleioso autou to ergon.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

verses.original: οὐχ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Ἔτι τετράμηνός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θερισμὸς ἔρχεται; ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐπάρατε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ θεάσασθε τὰς χώρας ὅτι λευκαί εἰσιν πρὸς θερισμόν· ἤδη
verses.translit: ouh umeis legete oti Eti tetraminos estin kai o therismos erhetai; idou lego umin, eparate tous ofthalmous umon kai theasasthe tas horas oti leykai eisin pros therismon* edi
verses.translation: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

verses.original: ⸀ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ⸀ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.
verses.translit: o therizon misthon lamvanei kai synagei karpon eis zoen aionion, ina o speiron omou haire kai o therizon.
verses.translation: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

verses.original: ἐν γὰρ τούτῳ ὁ λόγος ⸀ἐστὶν ἀληθινὸς ὅτι Ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ σπείρων καὶ ἄλλος ὁ θερίζων·
verses.translit: en gar toyto o logos estin alithinos oti Allos estin o speiron kai allos o therizon*
verses.translation: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς θερίζειν ὃ οὐχ ὑμεῖς κεκοπιάκατε· ἄλλοι κεκοπιάκασιν, καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν κόπον αὐτῶν εἰσεληλύθατε.
verses.translit: ego apesteila umas therizein o ouh umeis kekopiakate* alloi kekopiakasin, kai umeis eis ton kopon auton eiselilythate.
verses.translation: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

verses.original: Ἐκ δὲ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν τῶν Σαμαριτῶν διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς γυναικὸς μαρτυρούσης ὅτι Εἶπέν μοι πάντα ⸀ἃ ἐποίησα.
verses.translit: Ek de tes poleos ekeinis polloi episteysan eis auton ton Samariton dia ton logon tes gynaikos martyroysis oti Eipen moi panta a epoiisa.
verses.translation: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

verses.original: ὡς οὖν ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Σαμαρῖται, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν μεῖναι παρʼ αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ δύο ἡμέρας.
verses.translit: os oun elthon pros auton oi Samaritai, eroton auton meinai par' autois* kai emeinen ekei dyo emeras.
verses.translation: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

verses.original: καὶ πολλῷ πλείους ἐπίστευσαν διὰ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: kai pollo pleioys episteysan dia ton logon autou,
verses.translation: And many more believed because of his own word;

verses.original: τῇ τε γυναικὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὐκέτι διὰ τὴν σὴν λαλιὰν πιστεύομεν· αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ σωτὴρ τοῦ ⸀κόσμου.
verses.translit: te te gynaiki elegon oti Ouketi dia ten sen lalian pisteyomen* autoi gar akikoamen, kai oidamen oti outos estin alithos o soter tou kosmoy.
verses.translation: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς δύο ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ⸀ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν·
verses.translit: Meta de tas dyo emeras exelthen ekeithen eis ten Galilaian*
verses.translation: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

verses.original: αὐτὸς ⸀γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ πατρίδι τιμὴν οὐκ ἔχει.
verses.translit: autos gar Iisous emartyrisen oti profitis en te idia patridi timen ouk ehei.
verses.translation: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐδέξαντο αὐτὸν οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι, πάντα ἑωρακότες ⸀ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, καὶ αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν.
verses.translit: ote oun elthen eis ten Galilaian, edexanto auton oi Galilaioi, panta eorakotes osa epoiisen en Ierosolymois en te eorte, kai autoi gar elthon eis ten eortin.
verses.translation: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

verses.original: Ἦλθεν οὖν ⸀πάλιν εἰς τὴν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὅπου ἐποίησεν τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον. καὶ ἦν τις βασιλικὸς οὗ ὁ υἱὸς ἠσθένει ἐν Καφαρναούμ.
verses.translit: Elthen oun palin eis ten Kana tes Galilaias, opoy epoiisen to udor oinon. kai en tis vasilikos ou o yios esthenei en Kafarnaoym.
verses.translation: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

verses.original: οὗτος ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἥκει ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ⸀ἠρώτα ἵνα καταβῇ καὶ ἰάσηται αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱόν, ἤμελλεν γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκειν.
verses.translit: outos akoysas oti Iisous ekei ek tes Ioydaias eis ten Galilaian apelthen pros auton kai erota ina katave kai iasitai autou ton yion, emellen gar apothneskein.
verses.translation: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἐὰν μὴ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἴδητε, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε.
verses.translit: eipen oun o Iisous pros auton* Ean me simeia kai terata idite, ou me pisteysite.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

verses.original: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλικός· Κύριε, κατάβηθι πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν τὸ παιδίον μου.
verses.translit: legei pros auton o vasilikos* Kyrie, katavithi prin apothanein to paidion moy.
verses.translation: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πορεύου· ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ. ⸀ἐπίστευσεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῷ λόγῳ ⸀ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπορεύετο.
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* Poreyoy* o yios soy ze. episteysen o anthropos to logo on eipen auto o Iisous kai eporeyeto.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

verses.original: ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ καταβαίνοντος οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ ⸀ὑπήντησαν ⸀αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ παῖς ⸀αὐτοῦ ζῇ.
verses.translit: edi de autou katavainontos oi douloi autou upintisan auto legontes oti o pais autou ze.
verses.translation: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him , saying, Thy son liveth.

verses.original: ἐπύθετο οὖν ⸂τὴν ὥραν παρʼ αὐτῶν⸃ ἐν ᾗ κομψότερον ἔσχεν· ⸂εἶπαν οὖν⸃ αὐτῷ ὅτι ⸀Ἐχθὲς ὥραν ἑβδόμην ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ὁ πυρετός.
verses.translit: epytheto oun ten oran par' auton en e kompsoteron eshen* eipan oun auto oti Ehthes oran evdomin afeken auton o pyretos.
verses.translation: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

verses.original: ἔγνω οὖν ὁ πατὴρ ⸀ὅτι ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐν ᾗ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ⸀Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ, καὶ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ οἰκία αὐτοῦ ὅλη.
verses.translit: egno oun o pater oti ekeine te ora en e eipen auto o Iisous* O yios soy ze, kai episteysen autos kai e oikia autou oli.
verses.translation: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

verses.original: τοῦτο ⸀δὲ πάλιν δεύτερον σημεῖον ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.translit: touto de palin deyteron simeion epoiisen o Iisous elthon ek tes Ioydaias eis ten Galilaian.
verses.translation: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ⸀ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ⸀ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.
verses.translit: Meta tauta en eorte ton Ioydaion, kai anevi Iisous eis Ierosolyma.
verses.translation: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.original: ἔστιν δὲ ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα ἡ ἐπιλεγομένη Ἑβραϊστὶ ⸀Βηθεσδά, πέντε στοὰς ἔχουσα·
verses.translit: estin de en tois Ierosolymois epi te provatike kolymvithra e epilegomeni Evraisti Vithesda, pente stoas ehoysa*
verses.translation: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

verses.original: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο ⸀πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων, τυφλῶν, χωλῶν, ⸀ξηρῶν.
verses.translit: en taytais katekeito plethos ton asthenoynton, tyflon, holon, xiron.
verses.translation: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

verses.original: ἦν δέ τις ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ ⸀τριάκοντα ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἔχων ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ ⸀αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: en de tis anthropos ekei triakonta okto eti ehon en te astheneia autou*
verses.translation: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

verses.original: τοῦτον ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς κατακείμενον, καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι πολὺν ἤδη χρόνον ἔχει, λέγει αὐτῷ· Θέλεις ὑγιὴς γενέσθαι;
verses.translit: touton idon o Iisous katakeimenon, kai gnous oti polun edi hronon ehei, legei auto* Theleis ugies genesthai;
verses.translation: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ἀσθενῶν· Κύριε, ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἔχω ἵνα ὅταν ταραχθῇ τὸ ὕδωρ βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν· ἐν ᾧ δὲ ἔρχομαι ἐγὼ ἄλλος πρὸ ἐμοῦ καταβαίνει.
verses.translit: apekrithi auto o asthenon* Kyrie, anthropon ouk eho ina otan tarahthe to udor vale me eis ten kolymvithran* en o de erhomai ego allos pro emou katavainei.
verses.translation: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ⸀Ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* Egeire aron ton kravatton soy kai peripatei.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

verses.original: καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἦρε τὸν κράβαττον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει. Ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: kai eutheos egeneto ugies o anthropos kai ere ton kravatton autou kai periepatei. En de savvaton en ekeine te emera.
verses.translation: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ· Σάββατόν ἐστιν, ⸀καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι τὸν ⸀κράβαττον.
verses.translit: elegon oun oi Ioydaioi to tetherapeymeno* Savvaton estin, kai ouk exestin soi arai ton kravatton.
verses.translation: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

verses.original: ⸂ὃς δὲ⸃ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς· Ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.
verses.translit: os de apekrithi autois* O poiisas me ugie ekeinos moi eipen Aron ton kravatton soy kai peripatei.
verses.translation: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

verses.original: ἠρώτησαν ⸀οὖν αὐτόν· Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι· ⸀Ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει;
verses.translit: erotisan oun auton* Tis estin o anthropos o eipon soi* Aron kai peripatei;
verses.translation: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν, ὁ γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ.
verses.translit: o de iatheis ouk edei tis estin, o gar Iisous exeneysen ohloy ontos en to topo.
verses.translation: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

verses.original: μετὰ ταῦτα εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἴδε ὑγιὴς γέγονας· μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε, ἵνα μὴ χεῖρόν ⸂σοί τι⸃ γένηται.
verses.translit: meta tauta euriskei auton o Iisous en to iero kai eipen auto* Ide ugies gegonas* miketi amartane, ina me heiron soi ti genitai.
verses.translation: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

verses.original: ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ⸀ἀνήγγειλεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ.
verses.translit: apelthen o anthropos kai aniggeilen tois Ioydaiois oti Iisous estin o poiisas auton ugie.
verses.translation: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

verses.original: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐδίωκον ⸂οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τὸν Ἰησοῦν⸃ ὅτι ταῦτα ἐποίει ἐν σαββάτῳ.
verses.translit: kai dia touto ediokon oi Ioydaioi ton Iisoun oti tauta epoiei en savvato.
verses.translation: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

verses.original: ὁ ⸀δὲ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς· Ὁ πατήρ μου ἕως ἄρτι ἐργάζεται κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι.
verses.translit: o de apekrinato autois* O patir moy eos arti ergazetai kago ergazomai.
verses.translation: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο οὖν μᾶλλον ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυε τὸ σάββατον, ἀλλὰ καὶ πατέρα ἴδιον ἔλεγε τὸν θεόν, ἴσον ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.translit: dia touto oun mallon ezitoyn auton oi Ioydaioi apokteinai oti ou monon elye to savvaton, alla kai patera idion elege ton theon, ison eayton poion to theo.
verses.translation: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίνατο οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ⸀ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ δύναται ὁ υἱὸς ποιεῖν ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ οὐδὲν ⸀ἐὰν μή τι βλέπῃ τὸν πατέρα ποιοῦντα· ἃ γὰρ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ, ταῦτα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς ὁμοίως ποιεῖ.
verses.translit: Apekrinato oun o Iisous kai elegen autois* Amen amen lego umin, ou dynatai o yios poiein af' eaytou ouden ean mi ti vlepe ton patera poiounta* a gar an ekeinos poie, tauta kai o yios omoios poiei.
verses.translation: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πάντα δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ, καὶ μείζονα τούτων δείξει αὐτῷ ἔργα, ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε.
verses.translit: o gar pater filei ton yion kai panta deiknysin auto a autos poiei, kai meizona toyton deixei auto erga, ina umeis thaymazite.
verses.translation: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζῳοποιεῖ, οὕτως καὶ ὁ υἱὸς οὓς θέλει ζῳοποιεῖ.
verses.translit: osper gar o pater egeirei tous nekrous kai zoopoiei, outos kai o yios ous thelei zoopoiei.
verses.translation: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα, ἀλλὰ τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκεν τῷ υἱῷ,
verses.translit: oude gar o pater krinei oudena, alla ten krisin pasan dedoken to yio,
verses.translation: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

verses.original: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν πατέρα. ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν.
verses.translit: ina pantes timosi ton yion kathos timosi ton patera. o me timon ton yion ou tima ton patera ton pempsanta auton.
verses.translation: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ τὸν λόγον μου ἀκούων καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ εἰς κρίσιν οὐκ ἔρχεται ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν.
verses.translit: Amen amen lego umin oti o ton logon moy akoyon kai pisteyon to pempsanti me ehei zoen aionion, kai eis krisin ouk erhetai alla metaveviken ek tou thanatoy eis ten zoin.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ⸀ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ⸀ζήσουσιν.
verses.translit: Amen amen lego umin oti erhetai ora kai nun estin ote oi nekroi akoysoysin tes fones tou yiou tou theou kai oi akoysantes zisoysin.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, οὕτως ⸂καὶ τῷ υἱῷ ἔδωκεν⸃ ζωὴν ἔχειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ·
verses.translit: osper gar o pater ehei zoen en eayto, outos kai to yio edoken zoen ehein en eayto*
verses.translation: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

verses.original: καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔδωκεν ⸀αὐτῷ κρίσιν ποιεῖν, ὅτι υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν.
verses.translit: kai exoysian edoken auto krisin poiein, oti yios anthropoy estin.
verses.translation: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

verses.original: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ⸀ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.translit: me thaymazete touto, oti erhetai ora en e pantes oi en tois mnimeiois akoysoysin tes fones autou
verses.translation: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

verses.original: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ἀγαθὰ ποιήσαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς, οἱ ⸀δὲ τὰ φαῦλα πράξαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως.
verses.translit: kai ekporeysontai oi ta agatha poiisantes eis anastasin zoes, oi de ta faula praxantes eis anastasin kriseos.
verses.translation: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

verses.original: Οὐ δύναμαι ἐγὼ ποιεῖν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐδέν· καθὼς ἀκούω κρίνω, καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ δικαία ἐστίν, ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός ⸀με.
verses.translit: Ou dynamai ego poiein ap' emaytou ouden* kathos akoyo krino, kai e krisis e eme dikaia estin, oti ou zito to thelima to emon alla to thelima tou pempsantos me.
verses.translation: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἡ μαρτυρία μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής·
verses.translit: Ean ego martyro peri emaytou, e martyria moy ouk estin alithis*
verses.translation: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

verses.original: ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: allos estin o martyron peri emou, kai oida oti alithis estin e martyria en martyrei peri emou.
verses.translation: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάννην, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκε τῇ ἀληθείᾳ·
verses.translit: umeis apestalkate pros Ioannin, kai memartyrike te alitheia*
verses.translation: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου τὴν μαρτυρίαν λαμβάνω, ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λέγω ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε.
verses.translit: ego de ou para anthropoy ten martyrian lamvano, alla tauta lego ina umeis sothete.
verses.translation: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠθελήσατε ἀγαλλιαθῆναι πρὸς ὥραν ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: ekeinos en o lyhnos o kaiomenos kai fainon, umeis de ethelisate agalliathenai pros oran en to foti autou*
verses.translation: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν ⸀μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάννου, τὰ γὰρ ἔργα ἃ ⸀δέδωκέν μοι ὁ πατὴρ ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά, αὐτὰ τὰ ἔργα ⸀ἃ ποιῶ, μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ πατήρ με ἀπέσταλκεν,
verses.translit: ego de eho ten martyrian meizo tou Ioannoy, ta gar erga a dedoken moi o pater ina teleioso auta, auta ta erga a poio, martyrei peri emou oti o patir me apestalken,
verses.translation: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ ⸀ἐκεῖνος μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ ἐμοῦ. οὔτε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ⸂πώποτε ἀκηκόατε⸃ οὔτε εἶδος αὐτοῦ ἑωράκατε,
verses.translit: kai o pempsas me pater ekeinos memartyriken peri emou. oute fonen autou popote akikoate oute eidos autou eorakate,
verses.translation: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

verses.original: καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ⸂ἐν ὑμῖν μένοντα⸃, ὅτι ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος τούτῳ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε.
verses.translit: kai ton logon autou ouk ehete en umin menonta, oti on apesteilen ekeinos toyto umeis ou pisteyete.
verses.translation: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

verses.original: Ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔχειν· καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.translit: Eraynate tas grafas, oti umeis dokeite en autais zoen aionion ehein* kai ekeinai eisin ai martyrousai peri emou*
verses.translation: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

verses.original: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχητε.
verses.translit: kai ou thelete elthein pros me ina zoen ehite.
verses.translation: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

verses.original: δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ λαμβάνω,
verses.translit: doxan para anthropon ou lamvano,
verses.translation: I receive not honour from men.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.translit: alla egnoka umas oti ten agapin tou theou ouk ehete en eaytois.
verses.translation: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με· ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἰδίῳ, ἐκεῖνον λήμψεσθε.
verses.translit: ego elilytha en to onomati tou patros moy kai ou lamvanete me* ean allos elthe en to onomati to idio, ekeinon limpsesthe.
verses.translation: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

verses.original: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι, δόξαν παρʼ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες, καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου θεοῦ οὐ ζητεῖτε;
verses.translit: pos dynasthe umeis pisteusai, doxan par' allilon lamvanontes, kai ten doxan ten para tou monoy theou ou ziteite;
verses.translation: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

verses.original: μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα· ἔστιν ὁ κατηγορῶν ὑμῶν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε.
verses.translit: me dokeite oti ego katigoriso umon pros ton patera* estin o katigoron umon Moyses, eis on umeis elpikate.
verses.translation: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ, ἐπιστεύετε ἂν ἐμοί, περὶ γὰρ ἐμοῦ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν.
verses.translit: ei gar episteyete Moysei, episteyete an emoi, peri gar emou ekeinos egrapsen.
verses.translation: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν πιστεύσετε;
verses.translit: ei de tois ekeinoy grammasin ou pisteyete, pos tois emois Rimasin pisteysete;
verses.translation: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Γαλιλαίας τῆς Τιβεριάδος.
verses.translit: Meta tauta apelthen o Iisous peran tes thalassis tes Galilaias tes Tiveriados.
verses.translation: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

verses.original: ⸂ἠκολούθει δὲ⸃ αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, ὅτι ⸀ἐθεώρουν τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσθενούντων.
verses.translit: ekoloythei de auto ohlos polys, oti etheoroyn ta simeia a epoiei epi ton asthenoynton.
verses.translation: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

verses.original: ἀνῆλθεν δὲ εἰς τὸ ⸀ὄρος Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: anelthen de eis to oros Iisous, kai ekei ekathito meta ton mathiton autou.
verses.translation: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα, ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.translit: en de eggus to pasha, e eorte ton Ioydaion.
verses.translation: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

verses.original: ἐπάρας οὖν ⸂τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς⸃ καὶ θεασάμενος ὅτι πολὺς ὄχλος ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγει ⸀πρὸς Φίλιππον· Πόθεν ⸀ἀγοράσωμεν ἄρτους ἵνα φάγωσιν οὗτοι;
verses.translit: eparas oun tous ofthalmous o Iisous kai theasamenos oti polus ohlos erhetai pros auton legei pros Filippon* Pothen agorasomen artoys ina fagosin outoi;
verses.translation: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν πειράζων αὐτόν, αὐτὸς γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἔμελλεν ποιεῖν.
verses.translit: touto de elegen peirazon auton, autos gar edei ti emellen poiein.
verses.translation: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀αὐτῷ Φίλιππος· Διακοσίων δηναρίων ἄρτοι οὐκ ἀρκοῦσιν αὐτοῖς ἵνα ⸀ἕκαστος βραχύ ⸀τι λάβῃ.
verses.translit: apekrithi auto Filippos* Diakosion dinarion artoi ouk arkousin autois ina ekastos vrahy ti lave.
verses.translation: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου·
verses.translit: legei auto eis ek ton mathiton autou, Andreas o adelfos Simonos Petroy*
verses.translation: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,

verses.original: Ἔστιν ⸀παιδάριον ὧδε ⸀ὃς ἔχει πέντε ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ δύο ὀψάρια· ἀλλὰ ταῦτα τί ἐστιν εἰς τοσούτους;
verses.translit: Estin paidarion ode os ehei pente artoys krithinoys kai dyo opsaria* alla tauta ti estin eis tosoytoys;
verses.translation: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

verses.original: ⸀εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ποιήσατε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀναπεσεῖν. ἦν δὲ χόρτος πολὺς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ. ἀνέπεσαν οὖν οἱ ἄνδρες τὸν ἀριθμὸν ⸀ὡς πεντακισχίλιοι.
verses.translit: eipen o Iisous* Poiisate tous anthropoys anapesein. en de hortos polus en to topo. anepesan oun oi andres ton arithmon os pentakishilioi.
verses.translation: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

verses.original: ἔλαβεν ⸀οὖν τοὺς ἄρτους ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ⸀διέδωκεν τοῖς ἀνακειμένοις, ὁμοίως καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὅσον ἤθελον.
verses.translit: elaven oun tous artoys o Iisous kai euharistisas diedoken tois anakeimenois, omoios kai ek ton opsarion oson ethelon.
verses.translation: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

verses.original: ὡς δὲ ἐνεπλήσθησαν λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Συναγάγετε τὰ περισσεύσαντα κλάσματα, ἵνα μή τι ἀπόληται.
verses.translit: os de eneplisthisan legei tois mathitais autou* Synagagete ta perisseysanta klasmata, ina mi ti apolitai.
verses.translation: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

verses.original: συνήγαγον οὖν, καὶ ἐγέμισαν δώδεκα κοφίνους κλασμάτων ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἄρτων τῶν κριθίνων ἃ ⸀ἐπερίσσευσαν τοῖς βεβρωκόσιν.
verses.translit: synigagon oun, kai egemisan dodeka kofinoys klasmaton ek ton pente arton ton krithinon a eperisseysan tois vevrokosin.
verses.translation: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

verses.original: οἱ οὖν ἄνθρωποι ἰδόντες ⸂ὃ ἐποίησεν σημεῖον⸃ ⸀ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: oi oun anthropoi idontes o epoiisen simeion elegon oti Outos estin alithos o profitis o erhomenos eis ton kosmon.
verses.translation: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν γνοὺς ὅτι μέλλουσιν ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἁρπάζειν αὐτὸν ἵνα ⸀ποιήσωσιν βασιλέα ἀνεχώρησεν ⸀πάλιν εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτὸς μόνος.
verses.translit: Iisous oun gnous oti melloysin erhesthai kai arpazein auton ina poiisosin vasilea anehorisen palin eis to oros autos monos.
verses.translation: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ὀψία ἐγένετο κατέβησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,
verses.translit: Os de opsia egeneto katevisan oi mathitai autou epi ten thalassan,
verses.translation: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

verses.original: καὶ ἐμβάντες ⸀εἰς πλοῖον ἤρχοντο πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ σκοτία ἤδη ἐγεγόνει καὶ ⸀οὔπω ἐληλύθει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,
verses.translit: kai emvantes eis ploion erhonto peran tes thalassis eis Kafarnaoym. kai skotia edi egegonei kai oupo elilythei pros autous o Iisous,
verses.translation: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

verses.original: ἥ τε θάλασσα ἀνέμου μεγάλου πνέοντος ⸀διεγείρετο.
verses.translit: e te thalassa anemoy megaloy pneontos diegeireto.
verses.translation: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

verses.original: ἐληλακότες οὖν ὡς σταδίους εἴκοσι πέντε ἢ τριάκοντα θεωροῦσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐγγὺς τοῦ πλοίου γινόμενον, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.
verses.translit: elilakotes oun os stadioys eikosi pente e triakonta theorousin ton Iisoun peripatounta epi tes thalassis kai eggus tou ploioy ginomenon, kai efovithisan.
verses.translation: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.
verses.translit: o de legei autois* Ego eimi, me foveisthe.
verses.translation: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

verses.original: ἤθελον οὖν λαβεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ εὐθέως ⸂ἐγένετο τὸ πλοῖον⸃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑπῆγον.
verses.translit: ethelon oun lavein auton eis to ploion, kai eutheos egeneto to ploion epi tes ges eis en upegon.
verses.translation: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ἑστηκὼς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης ⸀εἶδον ὅτι πλοιάριον ἄλλο οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἰ μὴ ⸀ἕν, καὶ ὅτι οὐ συνεισῆλθεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ⸀πλοῖον ἀλλὰ μόνοι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον·
verses.translit: Te epayrion o ohlos o estikos peran tes thalassis eidon oti ploiarion allo ouk en ekei ei me en, kai oti ou syneiselthen tois mathitais autou o Iisous eis to ploion alla monoi oi mathitai autou apelthon*
verses.translation: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

verses.original: ⸀ἀλλὰ ἦλθεν ⸀πλοιάρια ἐκ Τιβεριάδος ἐγγὺς τοῦ τόπου ὅπου ἔφαγον τὸν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσαντος τοῦ κυρίου.
verses.translit: alla elthen ploiaria ek Tiveriados eggus tou topoy opoy efagon ton arton euharistisantos tou kyrioy.
verses.translation: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ οὐδὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, ἐνέβησαν αὐτοὶ εἰς τὰ ⸀πλοιάρια καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ζητοῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.translit: ote oun eiden o ohlos oti Iisous ouk estin ekei oude oi mathitai autou, enevisan autoi eis ta ploiaria kai elthon eis Kafarnaoum zitountes ton Iisoun.
verses.translation: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπον αὐτῷ· Ῥαββί, πότε ὧδε γέγονας;
verses.translit: Kai eurontes auton peran tes thalassis eipon auto* Ravvi, pote ode gegonas;
verses.translation: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητεῖτέ με οὐχ ὅτι εἴδετε σημεῖα ἀλλʼ ὅτι ἐφάγετε ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων καὶ ἐχορτάσθητε·
verses.translit: apekrithi autois o Iisous kai eipen* Amen amen lego umin, ziteite me ouh oti eidete simeia all' oti efagete ek ton arton kai ehortasthite*
verses.translation: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

verses.original: ἐργάζεσθε μὴ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν ἀπολλυμένην ἀλλὰ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν μένουσαν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἣν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑμῖν δώσει, τοῦτον γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐσφράγισεν ὁ θεός.
verses.translit: ergazesthe me ten vrosin ten apollymenin alla ten vrosin ten menoysan eis zoen aionion, en o yios tou anthropoy umin dosei, touton gar o pater esfragisen o theos.
verses.translation: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν· Τί ποιῶμεν ἵνα ἐργαζώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ;
verses.translit: eipon oun pros auton* Ti poiomen ina ergazometha ta erga tou theou;
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἔργον τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα ⸀πιστεύητε εἰς ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος.
verses.translit: apekrithi o Iisous kai eipen autois* Touto estin to ergon tou theou ina pisteyite eis on apesteilen ekeinos.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ· Τί οὖν ποιεῖς σὺ σημεῖον, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμέν σοι; τί ἐργάζῃ;
verses.translit: eipon oun auto* Ti oun poieis su simeion, ina idomen kai pisteysomen soi; ti ergaze;
verses.translation: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸ μάννα ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον· Ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν.
verses.translit: oi pateres emon to manna efagon en te erimo, kathos estin gegrammenon* Arton ek tou ouranou edoken autois fagein.
verses.translation: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ Μωϋσῆς ⸀δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὁ πατήρ μου δίδωσιν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν ἀληθινόν·
verses.translit: eipen oun autois o Iisous* Amen amen lego umin, ou Moyses dedoken umin ton arton ek tou ouranou, all' o patir moy didosin umin ton arton ek tou ouranou ton alithinon*
verses.translation: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἄρτος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ καταβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ζωὴν διδοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ.
verses.translit: o gar artos tou theou estin o katavainon ek tou ouranou kai zoen didous to kosmo.
verses.translation: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν· Κύριε, πάντοτε δὸς ἡμῖν τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον.
verses.translit: eipon oun pros auton* Kyrie, pantote dos emin ton arton touton.
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

verses.original: ⸀Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς· ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ⸀ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ ⸀διψήσει πώποτε.
verses.translit: Eipen autois o Iisous* Ego eimi o artos tes zoes* o erhomenos pros eme ou me peinase, kai o pisteyon eis eme ou me dipsisei popote.
verses.translation: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ ἑωράκατέ με καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε.
verses.translit: all' eipon umin oti kai eorakate me kai ou pisteyete.
verses.translation: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

verses.original: πᾶν ὃ δίδωσίν μοι ὁ πατὴρ πρὸς ἐμὲ ἥξει, καὶ τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρός ⸀με οὐ μὴ ἐκβάλω ἔξω,
verses.translit: pan o didosin moi o pater pros eme exei, kai ton erhomenon pros me ou me ekvalo exo,
verses.translation: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

verses.original: ὅτι καταβέβηκα ⸀ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐχ ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με·
verses.translit: oti katavevika apo tou ouranou ouh ina poio to thelima to emon alla to thelima tou pempsantos me*
verses.translation: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

verses.original: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός ⸀με ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκέν μοι μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ ἀναστήσω ⸀αὐτὸ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: touto de estin to thelima tou pempsantos me ina pan o dedoken moi me apoleso ex autou alla anastiso auto te eshate emera.
verses.translation: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

verses.original: τοῦτο ⸀γάρ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ ⸂πατρός μου⸃ ἵνα πᾶς ὁ θεωρῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ⸀ἐγὼ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: touto gar estin to thelima tou patros moy ina pas o theoron ton yion kai pisteyon eis auton ehe zoen aionion, kai anastiso auton ego te eshate emera.
verses.translation: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.original: Ἐγόγγυζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἶπεν· Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ καταβὰς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,
verses.translit: Egoggyzon oun oi Ioydaioi peri autou oti eipen* Ego eimi o artos o katavas ek tou ouranou,
verses.translation: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον· ⸀Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ, οὗ ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα; πῶς ⸀νῦν ⸀λέγει ὅτι Ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβέβηκα;
verses.translit: kai elegon* Ouh outos estin Iisous o yios Iosif, ou emeis oidamen ton patera kai ten mitera; pos nun legei oti Ek tou ouranou katavevika;
verses.translation: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

verses.original: ⸀ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Μὴ γογγύζετε μετʼ ἀλλήλων.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen autois* Me goggyzete met' allilon.
verses.translation: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός ⸀με ἐὰν μὴ ὁ πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με ἑλκύσῃ αὐτόν, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: oudeis dynatai elthein pros me ean me o pater o pempsas me elkyse auton, kago anastiso auton en te eshate emera.
verses.translation: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.original: ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις· Καὶ ἔσονται πάντες διδακτοὶ θεοῦ· ⸀πᾶς ὁ ⸀ἀκούσας παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μαθὼν ἔρχεται πρὸς ⸀ἐμέ.
verses.translit: estin gegrammenon en tois profitais* Kai esontai pantes didaktoi theou* pas o akoysas para tou patros kai mathon erhetai pros eme.
verses.translation: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι τὸν πατέρα ⸂ἑώρακέν τις⸃ εἰ μὴ ὁ ὢν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, οὗτος ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα.
verses.translit: ouh oti ton patera eoraken tis ei me o on para tou theou, outos eoraken ton patera.
verses.translation: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ ⸀πιστεύων ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, o pisteyon ehei zoen aionion.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς·
verses.translit: ego eimi o artos tes zoes*
verses.translation: I am that bread of life.

verses.original: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἔφαγον ⸂ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ μάννα⸃ καὶ ἀπέθανον·
verses.translit: oi pateres umon efagon en te erimo to manna kai apethanon*
verses.translation: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνων ἵνα τις ἐξ αὐτοῦ φάγῃ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ·
verses.translit: outos estin o artos o ek tou ouranou katavainon ina tis ex autou fage kai me apothane*
verses.translation: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ζῶν ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς· ἐάν τις φάγῃ ἐκ τούτου τοῦ ἄρτου ⸀ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ ὁ ἄρτος δὲ ὃν ἐγὼ δώσω ἡ σάρξ μού ⸀ἐστιν ὑπὲρ τῆς τοῦ κόσμου ζωῆς.
verses.translit: ego eimi o artos o zon o ek tou ouranou katavas* ean tis fage ek toytoy tou artoy zisei eis ton aiona, kai o artos de on ego doso e sarx moy estin uper tes tou kosmoy zoes.
verses.translation: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.original: Ἐμάχοντο οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες· Πῶς δύναται οὗτος ἡμῖν δοῦναι τὴν σάρκα ⸀αὐτοῦ φαγεῖν;
verses.translit: Emahonto oun pros alliloys oi Ioydaioi legontes* Pos dynatai outos emin dounai ten sarka autou fagein;
verses.translation: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ φάγητε τὴν σάρκα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πίητε αὐτοῦ τὸ αἷμα, οὐκ ἔχετε ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.translit: eipen oun autois o Iisous* Amen amen lego umin, ean me fagite ten sarka tou yiou tou anthropoy kai piite autou to aima, ouk ehete zoen en eaytois.
verses.translation: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

verses.original: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: o trogon moy ten sarka kai pinon moy to aima ehei zoen aionion, kago anastiso auton te eshate emera.
verses.translation: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σάρξ μου ⸀ἀληθής ἐστι βρῶσις, καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ⸁ἀληθής ἐστι πόσις.
verses.translit: e gar sarx moy alithis esti vrosis, kai to aima moy alithis esti posis.
verses.translation: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

verses.original: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μένει κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: o trogon moy ten sarka kai pinon moy to aima en emoi menei kago en auto.
verses.translation: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

verses.original: καθὼς ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ ζῶν πατὴρ κἀγὼ ζῶ διὰ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ὁ τρώγων με κἀκεῖνος ⸀ζήσει διʼ ἐμέ.
verses.translit: kathos apesteilen me o zon pater kago zo dia ton patera, kai o trogon me kakeinos zisei di' eme.
verses.translation: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ⸀ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, οὐ καθὼς ἔφαγον οἱ ⸀πατέρες καὶ ἀπέθανον· ὁ τρώγων τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον ⸀ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.translit: outos estin o artos o ex ouranou katavas, ou kathos efagon oi pateres kai apethanon* o trogon touton ton arton zisei eis ton aiona.
verses.translation: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

verses.original: ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν συναγωγῇ διδάσκων ἐν Καφαρναούμ.
verses.translit: tauta eipen en synagoge didaskon en Kafarnaoym.
verses.translation: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

verses.original: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἀκούσαντες ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπαν· Σκληρός ἐστιν ⸂ὁ λόγος οὗτος⸃· τίς δύναται αὐτοῦ ἀκούειν;
verses.translit: Polloi oun akoysantes ek ton mathiton autou eipan* Skliros estin o logos outos* tis dynatai autou akoyein;
verses.translation: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this , said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

verses.original: εἰδὼς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι γογγύζουσιν περὶ τούτου οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τοῦτο ὑμᾶς σκανδαλίζει;
verses.translit: eidos de o Iisous en eayto oti goggyzoysin peri toytoy oi mathitai autou eipen autois* Touto umas skandalizei;
verses.translation: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν θεωρῆτε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναβαίνοντα ὅπου ἦν τὸ πρότερον;
verses.translit: ean oun theorete ton yion tou anthropoy anavainonta opoy en to proteron;
verses.translation: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ ζῳοποιοῦν, ἡ σὰρξ οὐκ ὠφελεῖ οὐδέν· τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ ⸀λελάληκα ὑμῖν πνεῦμά ἐστιν καὶ ζωή ἐστιν.
verses.translit: to pneuma estin to zoopoioun, e sarx ouk ofelei ouden* ta Rimata a ego lelalika umin pneuma estin kai zoi estin.
verses.translation: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ εἰσὶν ἐξ ὑμῶν τινες οἳ οὐ πιστεύουσιν. ᾔδει γὰρ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ μὴ πιστεύοντες καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδώσων αὐτόν.
verses.translit: alla eisin ex umon tines oi ou pisteyoysin. edei gar ex arhes o Iisous tines eisin oi me pisteyontes kai tis estin o paradoson auton.
verses.translation: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγεν· Διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ ⸀πατρός.
verses.translit: kai elegen* Dia touto eirika umin oti oudeis dynatai elthein pros me ean me e dedomenon auto ek tou patros.
verses.translation: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

verses.original: Ἐκ τούτου πολλοὶ ⸀ἐκ ⸂τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον⸃ εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ οὐκέτι μετʼ αὐτοῦ περιεπάτουν.
verses.translit: Ek toytoy polloi ek ton mathiton autou apelthon eis ta opiso kai ouketi met' autou periepatoyn.
verses.translation: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς δώδεκα· Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε ὑπάγειν;
verses.translit: eipen oun o Iisous tois dodeka* Me kai umeis thelete upagein;
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

verses.original: ⸀ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα; ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις,
verses.translit: apekrithi auto Simon Petros* Kyrie, pros tina apeleysometha; Rimata zoes aionioy eheis,
verses.translation: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ⸀ἅγιος τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ.
verses.translit: kai emeis pepisteykamen kai egnokamen oti su ei o agios tou theou.
verses.translation: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς τοὺς δώδεκα ἐξελεξάμην; καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἷς διάβολός ἐστιν.
verses.translit: apekrithi autois o Iisous* Ouk ego umas tous dodeka exelexamin; kai ex umon eis diavolos estin.
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

verses.original: ἔλεγεν δὲ τὸν Ἰούδαν Σίμωνος ⸀Ἰσκαριώτου· οὗτος γὰρ ἔμελλεν ⸂παραδιδόναι αὐτόν⸃, ⸀εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα.
verses.translit: elegen de ton Ioydan Simonos Iskariotoy* outos gar emellen paradidonai auton, eis ek ton dodeka.
