verses.translation: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸂μετὰ ταῦτα περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς⸃ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, οὐ γὰρ ἤθελεν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περιπατεῖν, ὅτι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι.
verses.translit: Kai meta tauta periepatei o Iisous en te Galilaia, ou gar ethelen en te Ioydaia peripatein, oti ezitoyn auton oi Ioydaioi apokteinai.
verses.translation: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἡ σκηνοπηγία.
verses.translit: en de eggus e eorte ton Ioydaion e skinopigia.
verses.translation: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ· Μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, ἵνα καὶ οἱ μαθηταί σου ⸀θεωρήσουσιν ⸂σοῦ τὰ ἔργα⸃ ἃ ποιεῖς·
verses.translit: eipon oun pros auton oi adelfoi autou* Metavithi enteuthen kai upage eis ten Ioydaian, ina kai oi mathitai soy theorisoysin sou ta erga a poieis*
verses.translation: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς γάρ ⸂τι ἐν κρυπτῷ⸃ ποιεῖ καὶ ζητεῖ αὐτὸς ἐν παρρησίᾳ εἶναι· εἰ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ.
verses.translit: oudeis gar ti en krypto poiei kai zitei autos en parrisia einai* ei tauta poieis, faneroson seayton to kosmo.
verses.translation: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν.
verses.translit: oude gar oi adelfoi autou episteyon eis auton.
verses.translation: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

verses.original: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ καιρὸς ὁ ἐμὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν, ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὁ ὑμέτερος πάντοτέ ἐστιν ἕτοιμος.
verses.translit: legei oun autois o Iisous* O kairos o emos oupo parestin, o de kairos o umeteros pantote estin etoimos.
verses.translation: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

verses.original: οὐ δύναται ὁ κόσμος μισεῖν ὑμᾶς, ἐμὲ δὲ μισεῖ, ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρά ἐστιν.
verses.translit: ou dynatai o kosmos misein umas, eme de misei, oti ego martyro peri autou oti ta erga autou ponira estin.
verses.translation: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ⸀ἑορτήν· ἐγὼ ⸀οὐκ ἀναβαίνω εἰς τὴν ἑορτὴν ταύτην, ὅτι ὁ ⸂ἐμὸς καιρὸς⸃ οὔπω πεπλήρωται.
verses.translit: umeis anavite eis ten eortin* ego ouk anavaino eis ten eorten taytin, oti o emos kairos oupo peplirotai.
verses.translation: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

verses.original: ταῦτα ⸀δὲ εἰπὼν ⸀αὐτὸς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.
verses.translit: tauta de eipon autos emeinen en te Galilaia.
verses.translation: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ⸂εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνέβη⸃, οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ.
verses.translit: Os de anevisan oi adelfoi autou eis ten eortin, tote kai autos anevi, ou faneros alla os en krypto.
verses.translation: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

verses.original: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος;
verses.translit: oi oun Ioydaioi ezitoyn auton en te eorte kai elegon* Pou estin ekeinos;
verses.translation: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

verses.original: καὶ γογγυσμὸς ⸂περὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν πολὺς⸃ ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις· οἱ μὲν ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἀγαθός ἐστιν, ἄλλοι ⸀δὲ ἔλεγον· Οὔ, ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον.
verses.translit: kai goggysmos peri autou en polus en tois ohlois* oi men elegon oti Agathos estin, alloi de elegon* Ou, alla plana ton ohlon.
verses.translation: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς μέντοι παρρησίᾳ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.translit: oudeis mentoi parrisia elalei peri autou dia ton fovon ton Ioydaion.
verses.translation: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

verses.original: Ἤδη δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς μεσούσης ⸀ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν.
verses.translit: Edi de tes eortes mesoysis anevi Iisous eis to ieron kai edidasken.
verses.translation: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

verses.original: ⸂ἐθαύμαζον οὖν⸃ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες· Πῶς οὗτος γράμματα οἶδεν μὴ μεμαθηκώς;
verses.translit: ethaymazon oun oi Ioydaioi legontes* Pos outos grammata oiden me memathikos;
verses.translation: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτοῖς ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Ἡ ἐμὴ διδαχὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὴ ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με·
verses.translit: apekrithi oun autois o Iisous kai eipen* E eme didahe ouk estin eme alla tou pempsantos me*
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

verses.original: ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν, γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ.
verses.translit: ean tis thele to thelima autou poiein, gnosetai peri tes didahes poteron ek tou theou estin e ego ap' emaytou lalo.
verses.translation: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

verses.original: ὁ ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ· ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.translit: o af' eaytou lalon ten doxan ten idian zitei* o de ziton ten doxan tou pempsantos auton outos alithis estin kai adikia en auto ouk estin.
verses.translation: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

verses.original: Οὐ Μωϋσῆς ⸀δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον; καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον. τί με ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.translit: Ou Moyses dedoken umin ton nomon; kai oudeis ex umon poiei ton nomon. ti me ziteite apokteinai;
verses.translation: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ⸀ὄχλος· Δαιμόνιον ἔχεις· τίς σε ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.translit: apekrithi o ohlos* Daimonion eheis* tis se zitei apokteinai;
verses.translation: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἓν ἔργον ἐποίησα καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen autois* En ergon epoiisa kai pantes thaymazete.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν— οὐχ ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐστὶν ἀλλʼ ἐκ τῶν πατέρων— καὶ ἐν σαββάτῳ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον.
verses.translit: dia touto Moyses dedoken umin ten peritomin-- ouh oti ek tou Moyseos estin all' ek ton pateron-- kai en savvato peritemnete anthropon.
verses.translation: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

verses.original: εἰ περιτομὴν ⸀λαμβάνει ἄνθρωπος ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα μὴ λυθῇ ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως, ἐμοὶ χολᾶτε ὅτι ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐποίησα ἐν σαββάτῳ;
verses.translit: ei peritomen lamvanei anthropos en savvato ina me lythe o nomos Moyseos, emoi holate oti olon anthropon ugie epoiisa en savvato;
verses.translation: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

verses.original: μὴ κρίνετε κατʼ ὄψιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν ⸀κρίνετε.
verses.translit: me krinete kat' opsin, alla ten dikaian krisin krinete.
verses.translation: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.translit: Elegon oun tines ek ton Ierosolymiton* Ouh outos estin on zitousin apokteinai;
verses.translation: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

verses.original: καὶ ἴδε παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖ καὶ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ λέγουσιν· μήποτε ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι οὗτός ⸀ἐστιν ὁ χριστός;
verses.translit: kai ide parrisia lalei kai ouden auto legoysin* mipote alithos egnosan oi arhontes oti outos estin o hristos;
verses.translation: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοῦτον οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔρχηται οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν.
verses.translit: alla touton oidamen pothen estin* o de hristos otan erhitai oudeis ginoskei pothen estin.
verses.translation: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

verses.original: ἔκραξεν οὖν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγων· Κἀμὲ οἴδατε καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί· καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὁ πέμψας με, ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε·
verses.translit: ekraxen oun en to iero didaskon o Iisous kai legon* Kame oidate kai oidate pothen eimi* kai ap' emaytou ouk elilytha, all' estin alithinos o pempsas me, on umeis ouk oidate*
verses.translation: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

verses.original: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν, ὅτι παρʼ αὐτοῦ εἰμι κἀκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
verses.translit: ego oida auton, oti par' autou eimi kakeinos me apesteilen.
verses.translation: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

verses.original: ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πιάσαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ezitoyn oun auton piasai, kai oudeis epevalen ep' auton ten heira, oti oupo elilythei e ora autou.
verses.translation: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

verses.original: ⸂ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ πολλοὶ⸃ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ⸀ἔλεγον· Ὁ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔλθῃ ⸀μὴ πλείονα ⸀σημεῖα ποιήσει ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν;
verses.translit: ek tou ohloy de polloi episteysan eis auton, kai elegon* O hristos otan elthe me pleiona simeia poiisei on outos epoiisen;
verses.translation: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

verses.original: Ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος περὶ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν ⸂οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὑπηρέτας⸃ ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: Ekoysan oi Farisaioi tou ohloy goggyzontos peri autou tauta, kai apesteilan oi arhiereis kai oi Farisaioi upiretas ina piasosin auton.
verses.translation: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔτι ⸂χρόνον μικρὸν⸃ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.translit: eipen oun o Iisous* Eti hronon mikron meth' umon eimi kai upago pros ton pempsanta me.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

verses.original: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ ⸀εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
verses.translit: zitisete me kai ouh eurisete, kai opoy eimi ego umeis ou dynasthe elthein.
verses.translation: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς ἑαυτούς· Ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν; μὴ εἰς τὴν διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων μέλλει πορεύεσθαι καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας;
verses.translit: eipon oun oi Ioydaioi pros eaytoys* Pou outos mellei poreyesthai oti emeis ouh eurisomen auton; me eis ten diasporan ton Ellinon mellei poreyesthai kai didaskein tous Ellinas;
verses.translation: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

verses.original: τίς ἐστιν ⸂ὁ λόγος οὗτος⸃ ὃν εἶπε· Ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ ⸀εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
verses.translit: tis estin o logos outos on eipe* Zitisete me kai ouh eurisete, kai opoy eimi ego umeis ou dynasthe elthein;
verses.translation: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ μεγάλῃ τῆς ἑορτῆς εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων· Ἐάν τις διψᾷ ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω.
verses.translit: En de te eshate emera te megale tes eortes eistikei o Iisous, kai ekraxen legon* Ean tis dipsa erhestho pros me kai pineto.
verses.translation: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ, καθὼς εἶπεν ἡ γραφή, ποταμοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ ῥεύσουσιν ὕδατος ζῶντος.
verses.translit: o pisteyon eis eme, kathos eipen e grafi, potamoi ek tes koilias autou Reysoysin udatos zontos.
verses.translation: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ πνεύματος ⸀οὗ ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν οἱ ⸀πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν· οὔπω γὰρ ἦν ⸀πνεῦμα, ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ⸀οὐδέπω ἐδοξάσθη.
verses.translit: touto de eipen peri tou pneymatos ou emellon lamvanein oi pisteysantes eis auton* oupo gar en pneuma, oti Iisous oudepo edoxasthi.
verses.translation: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

verses.original: ⸂Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου οὖν⸃ ἀκούσαντες ⸂τῶν λόγων τούτων⸃ ⸀ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης·
verses.translit: Ek tou ohloy oun akoysantes ton logon toyton elegon* Outos estin alithos o profitis*
verses.translation: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

verses.original: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός· ⸂οἱ δὲ⸃ ἔλεγον· Μὴ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὁ χριστὸς ἔρχεται;
verses.translit: alloi elegon* Outos estin o hristos* oi de elegon* Me gar ek tes Galilaias o hristos erhetai;
verses.translation: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

verses.original: ⸀οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλέεμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου ἦν Δαυίδ, ⸂ἔρχεται ὁ χριστός⸃;
verses.translit: ouh e grafe eipen oti ek tou spermatos Dayid, kai apo Vithleem tes komis opoy en Dayid, erhetai o hristos;
verses.translation: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

verses.original: σχίσμα οὖν ⸂ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ⸃ διʼ αὐτόν.
verses.translit: shisma oun egeneto en to ohlo di' auton.
verses.translation: So there was a division among the people because of him.

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ ἤθελον ἐξ αὐτῶν πιάσαι αὐτόν, ἀλλʼ οὐδεὶς ⸀ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας.
verses.translit: tines de ethelon ex auton piasai auton, all' oudeis epevalen ep' auton tas heiras.
verses.translation: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

verses.original: Ἦλθον οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους, καὶ εἶπον αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι· Διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν;
verses.translit: Elthon oun oi upiretai pros tous arhiereis kai Farisaioys, kai eipon autois ekeinoi* Dia ti ouk egagete auton;
verses.translation: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ὑπηρέται· Οὐδέποτε ⸂ἐλάλησεν οὕτως⸃ ⸀ἄνθρωπος.
verses.translit: apekrithisan oi upiretai* Oudepote elalisen outos anthropos.
verses.translation: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν αὐτοῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς πεπλάνησθε;
verses.translit: apekrithisan oun autois oi Farisaioi* Me kai umeis peplanisthe;
verses.translation: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

verses.original: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων;
verses.translit: mi tis ek ton arhonton episteysen eis auton e ek ton Farisaion;
verses.translation: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὁ ὄχλος οὗτος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον ⸀ἐπάρατοί εἰσιν.
verses.translit: alla o ohlos outos o me ginoskon ton nomon eparatoi eisin.
verses.translation: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

verses.original: λέγει Νικόδημος πρὸς αὐτούς, ὁ ⸀ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν ⸀πρότερον, εἷς ὢν ἐξ αὐτῶν·
verses.translit: legei Nikodimos pros autoys, o elthon pros auton proteron, eis on ex auton*
verses.translation: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

verses.original: Μὴ ὁ νόμος ἡμῶν κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ ⸂πρῶτον παρʼ αὐτοῦ⸃ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ;
verses.translit: Me o nomos emon krinei ton anthropon ean me akoyse proton par' autou kai gno ti poiei;
verses.translation: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶ; ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι ⸂ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας προφήτης⸃ οὐκ ⸀ἐγείρεται.
verses.translit: apekrithisan kai eipan auto* Me kai su ek tes Galilaias ei; eraynison kai ide oti ek tes Galilaias profitis ouk egeiretai.
verses.translation: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

verses.original: ⟦καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: kai eporeythi ekastos eis ton oikon autou*
verses.translation: And every man went unto his own house.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.
verses.translit: Iisous de eporeythi eis to oros ton Elaion.
verses.translation: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

verses.original: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο· καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.
verses.translit: Orthroy de palin paregeneto eis to ieron, kai pas o laos erheto* kai kathisas edidasken autoys.
verses.translation: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

verses.original: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐν μοιχείᾳ καταλήφθεισαν· καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ,
verses.translit: agoysin de oi grammateis kai oi Farisaioi pros auton gynaika en moiheia kataliftheisan* kai stisantes auten en meso,
verses.translation: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, πειράζοντες· Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατελήφθη ἐπʼ αὐτοφόρῳ μοιχευομένη.
verses.translit: legoysin auto, peirazontes* Didaskale, auti e gyne katelifthi ep' autoforo moiheyomeni.
verses.translation: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθοβολεῖσθαι· σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;
verses.translit: en de to nomo Moses emin eneteilato tas toiaytas lithovoleisthai* su oun ti legeis;
verses.translation: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν, ἵνα ἔχωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας, τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν, μὴ προσποιούμενος.
verses.translit: touto de elegon peirazontes auton, ina ehosin katigorein autou. o de Iisous kato kypsas, to daktylo egrafen eis ten gen, me prospoioymenos.
verses.translation: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not .

verses.original: ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνακύψας εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν, πρῶτον ἐπʼ αὐτὴν τὸν λίθον βαλέτω.
verses.translit: os de epemenon erotontes auton, anakypsas eipen pros autoys* O anamartitos umon, proton ep' auten ton lithon valeto.
verses.translation: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν κάτω κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.
verses.translit: kai palin kato kypsas egrafen eis ten gen.
verses.translation: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

verses.original: οἱ δέ, ἀκούσαντες, καὶ ὑπὸ τῆς συνειδήσεως ἐλεγχόμενοι, ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθʼ εἷς, ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων· καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα.
verses.translit: oi de, akoysantes, kai upo tes syneidiseos eleghomenoi, exirhonto eis kath' eis, arxamenoi apo ton presvyteron* kai kateleifthi monos o Iisous, kai e gyne en meso ousa.
verses.translation: And they which heard it , being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

verses.original: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ μηδένα θεασάμενος πλὴν τὴς γυναικός, εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Ποῦ εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου; Οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;
verses.translit: anakypsas de o Iisous, kai midena theasamenos plen tes gynaikos, eipen aute* Pou eisin ekeinoi oi katigoroi soy; Oudeis se katekrinen;
verses.translation: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

verses.original: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν· Οὐδείς, κύριε. εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κρίνω· πορεύου καὶ μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε.⟧
verses.translit: e de eipen* Oudeis, kyrie. eipen de o Iisous* Oude ego se krino* poreyoy kai miketi amartane.
verses.translation: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

verses.original: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ⸂ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς⸃ λέγων· Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου· ὁ ἀκολουθῶν ⸀ἐμοὶ οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλʼ ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.
verses.translit: Palin oun autois elalisen o Iisous legon* Ego eimi to fos tou kosmoy* o akoloython emoi ou me peripatise en te skotia, all' exei to fos tes zoes.
verses.translation: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς· ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής.
verses.translit: eipon oun auto oi Farisaioi* Su peri seaytou martyreis* e martyria soy ouk estin alithis.
verses.translation: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου, ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω· ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ⸀ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen autois* Kan ego martyro peri emaytou, alithis estin e martyria moy, oti oida pothen elthon kai pou upago* umeis de ouk oidate pothen erhomai e pou upago.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα.
verses.translit: umeis kata ten sarka krinete, ego ou krino oudena.
verses.translation: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ, ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ⸀ἀληθινή ἐστιν, ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
verses.translit: kai ean krino de ego, e krisis e eme alithini estin, oti monos ouk eimi, all' ego kai o pempsas me patir.
verses.translation: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν.
verses.translit: kai en to nomo de to umetero gegraptai oti dyo anthropon e martyria alithis estin.
verses.translation: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
verses.translit: ego eimi o martyron peri emaytou kai martyrei peri emou o pempsas me patir.
verses.translation: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ πατήρ σου; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν πατέρα μου· εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ⸂ἂν ᾔδειτε⸃.
verses.translit: elegon oun auto* Pou estin o patir soy; apekrithi Iisous* Oute eme oidate oute ton patera moy* ei eme edeite, kai ton patera moy an edeite.
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

verses.original: ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ⸀ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ· καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: tauta ta Rimata elalisen en to gazofylakio didaskon en to iero* kai oudeis epiasen auton, oti oupo elilythei e ora autou.
verses.translation: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν ⸀αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε· ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
verses.translit: Eipen oun palin autois* Ego upago kai zitisete me, kai en te amartia umon apothaneisthe* opoy ego upago umeis ou dynasthe elthein.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτὸν ὅτι λέγει· Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
verses.translit: elegon oun oi Ioydaioi* Miti apoktenei eayton oti legei* Opoy ego upago umeis ou dynasthe elthein;
verses.translation: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί· ὑμεῖς ἐκ ⸂τούτου τοῦ κόσμου⸃ ἐστέ, ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.
verses.translit: kai elegen autois* Umeis ek ton kato este, ego ek ton ano eimi* umeis ek toytoy tou kosmoy este, ego ouk eimi ek tou kosmoy toytoy.
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν· ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: eipon oun umin oti apothaneisthe en tais amartiais umon* ean gar me pisteysite oti ego eimi, apothaneisthe en tais amartiais umon.
verses.translation: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he , ye shall die in your sins.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Σὺ τίς εἶ; ⸀εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ἀρχὴν ⸂ὅ τι⸃ καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν;
verses.translit: elegon oun auto* Su tis ei; eipen autois o Iisous* Ten arhen o ti kai lalo umin;
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

verses.original: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν· ἀλλʼ ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν, κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρʼ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα ⸀λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: polla eho peri umon lalein kai krinein* all' o pempsas me alithis estin, kago a ekoysa par' autou tauta lalo eis ton kosmon.
verses.translation: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

verses.original: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν.
verses.translit: ouk egnosan oti ton patera autois elegen.
verses.translation: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

verses.original: εἶπεν ⸀οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν, ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ ⸀πατὴρ ταῦτα λαλῶ.
verses.translit: eipen oun o Iisous* Otan upsosite ton yion tou anthropoy, tote gnosesthe oti ego eimi, kai ap' emaytou poio ouden, alla kathos edidaxen me o pater tauta lalo.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he , and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν· οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με ⸀μόνον, ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε.
verses.translit: kai o pempsas me met' emou estin* ouk afeken me monon, oti ego ta aresta auto poio pantote.
verses.translation: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

verses.original: ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν.
verses.translit: tauta autou lalountos polloi episteysan eis auton.
verses.translation: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους· Ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ, ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε,
verses.translit: Elegen oun o Iisous pros tous pepisteykotas auto Ioydaioys* Ean umeis meinite en to logo to emo, alithos mathitai moy este,
verses.translation: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

verses.original: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: kai gnosesthe ten alitheian, kai e alitheia eleytherosei umas.
verses.translation: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν ⸂πρὸς αὐτόν⸃· Σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε· πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι Ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε;
verses.translit: apekrithisan pros auton* Sperma Avraam esmen kai oudeni dedoyleykamen popote* pos su legeis oti Eleytheroi genisesthe;
verses.translation: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
verses.translit: Apekrithi autois o Iisous* Amen amen lego umin oti pas o poion ten amartian doulos estin tes amartias*
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ⸀ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.translit: o de doulos ou menei en te oikia eis ton aiona* o yios menei eis ton aiona.
verses.translation: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ, ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε.
verses.translit: ean oun o yios umas eleytherose, ontos eleytheroi esesthe.
verses.translation: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

verses.original: οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε· ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: oida oti sperma Avraam este* alla ziteite me apokteinai, oti o logos o emos ou horei en umin.
verses.translation: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

verses.original: ⸂ἃ ἐγὼ⸃ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ ⸀πατρὶ λαλῶ· καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ⸂ἃ ἠκούσατε⸃ παρὰ ⸂τοῦ πατρὸς⸃ ποιεῖτε.
verses.translit: a ego eoraka para to patri lalo* kai umeis oun a ekoysate para tou patros poieite.
verses.translation: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ⸀ἐστε, τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ⸀ἐποιεῖτε·
verses.translit: Apekrithisan kai eipan auto* O pater emon Avraam estin. legei autois o Iisous* Ei tekna tou Avraam este, ta erga tou Avraam epoieite*
verses.translation: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

verses.original: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ· τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν.
verses.translit: nun de ziteite me apokteinai, anthropon os ten alitheian umin lelalika en ekoysa para tou theou* touto Avraam ouk epoiisen.
verses.translation: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν. ⸀εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας ⸂οὐ γεγεννήμεθα⸃· ἕνα πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν θεόν.
verses.translit: umeis poieite ta erga tou patros umon. eipan auto* Emeis ek porneias ou gegennimetha* ena patera ehomen ton theon.
verses.translation: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

verses.original: ⸀εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ ὁ θεὸς πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
verses.translit: eipen autois o Iisous* Ei o theos pater umon en egapate an eme, ego gar ek tou theou exelthon kai eko* oude gar ap' emaytou elilytha, all' ekeinos me apesteilen.
verses.translation: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

verses.original: διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε; ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν.
verses.translit: dia ti ten lalian ten emen ou ginoskete; oti ou dynasthe akoyein ton logon ton emon.
verses.translation: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ⸂οὐκ ἔστηκεν⸃, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: umeis ek tou patros tou diavoloy este kai tas epithymias tou patros umon thelete poiein. ekeinos anthropoktonos en ap' arhes, kai en te alitheia ouk estiken, oti ouk estin alitheia en auto. otan lale to pseudos, ek ton idion lalei, oti pseystis estin kai o pater autou.
verses.translation: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι.
verses.translit: ego de oti ten alitheian lego, ou pisteyete moi.
verses.translation: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

verses.original: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας; ⸀εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω, διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι;
verses.translit: tis ex umon eleghei me peri amartias; ei alitheian lego, dia ti umeis ou pisteyete moi;
verses.translation: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

verses.original: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούει· διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ.
verses.translit: o on ek tou theou ta Rimata tou theou akoyei* dia touto umeis ouk akoyete oti ek tou theou ouk este.
verses.translation: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

verses.original: ⸀Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρίτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις;
verses.translit: Apekrithisan oi Ioydaioi kai eipan auto* Ou kalos legomen emeis oti Samaritis ei su kai daimonion eheis;
verses.translation: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω, ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous* Ego daimonion ouk eho, alla timo ton patera moy, kai umeis atimazete me.
verses.translation: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου· ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων.
verses.translit: ego de ou zito ten doxan moy* estin o ziton kai krinon.
verses.translation: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐάν τις τὸν ⸂ἐμὸν λόγον⸃ τηρήσῃ, θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, ean tis ton emon logon tirise, thanaton ou me theorise eis ton aiona.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

verses.original: ⸀εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις. Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται, καὶ σὺ λέγεις· Ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ, οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
verses.translit: eipon auto oi Ioydaioi* Nun egnokamen oti daimonion eheis. Avraam apethanen kai oi profetai, kai su legeis* Ean tis ton logon moy tirise, ou me geysitai thanatoy eis ton aiona*
verses.translation: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

verses.original: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ, ὅστις ἀπέθανεν; καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον· τίνα ⸀σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς;
verses.translit: me su meizon ei tou patros emon Avraam, ostis apethanen; kai oi profetai apethanon* tina seayton poieis;
verses.translation: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐὰν ἐγὼ ⸀δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν, ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν· ἔστιν ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι θεὸς ⸀ἡμῶν ἐστιν,
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous* Ean ego doxaso emayton, e doxa moy ouden estin* estin o patir moy o doxazon me, on umeis legete oti theos emon estin,
verses.translation: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν, ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν· κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ⸀ὑμῖν ψεύστης· ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ.
verses.translit: kai ouk egnokate auton, ego de oida auton* kan eipo oti ouk oida auton, esomai omoios umin pseystis* alla oida auton kai ton logon autou tiro.
verses.translation: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

verses.original: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη.
verses.translit: Avraam o pater umon egalliasato ina ide ten emeran ten emin, kai eiden kai ehari.
verses.translation: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it , and was glad.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν· Πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας;
verses.translit: eipon oun oi Ioydaioi pros auton* Pentikonta eti oupo eheis kai Avraam eorakas;
verses.translation: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

verses.original: εἶπεν ⸀αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί.
verses.translit: eipen autois Iisous* Amen amen lego umin, prin Avraam genesthai ego eimi.
verses.translation: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

verses.original: ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπʼ αὐτόν· Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ⸀ἱεροῦ.
verses.translit: eran oun lithoys ina valosin ep' auton* Iisous de ekryvi kai exelthen ek tou ierou.
verses.translation: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

verses.original: Καὶ παράγων εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον τυφλὸν ἐκ γενετῆς.
verses.translit: Kai paragon eiden anthropon tyflon ek genetes.
verses.translation: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

verses.original: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες· Ῥαββί, τίς ἥμαρτεν, οὗτος ἢ οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἵνα τυφλὸς γεννηθῇ;
verses.translit: kai erotisan auton oi mathitai autou legontes* Ravvi, tis emarten, outos e oi goneis autou, ina tyflos gennithe;
verses.translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὔτε οὗτος ἥμαρτεν οὔτε οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῇ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous* Oute outos emarten oute oi goneis autou, all' ina fanerothe ta erga tou theou en auto.
verses.translation: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

verses.original: ⸀ἡμᾶς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἕως ἡμέρα ἐστίν· ἔρχεται νὺξ ὅτε οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐργάζεσθαι.
verses.translit: emas dei ergazesthai ta erga tou pempsantos me eos emera estin* erhetai nux ote oudeis dynatai ergazesthai.
verses.translation: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

verses.original: ὅταν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὦ, φῶς εἰμι τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.translit: otan en to kosmo o, fos eimi tou kosmoy.
verses.translation: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

verses.original: ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἔπτυσεν χαμαὶ καὶ ἐποίησεν πηλὸν ἐκ τοῦ πτύσματος, καὶ ⸀ἐπέχρισεν ⸀αὐτοῦ τὸν πηλὸν ἐπὶ τοὺς ⸀ὀφθαλμούς,
verses.translit: tauta eipon eptysen hamai kai epoiisen pilon ek tou ptysmatos, kai epehrisen autou ton pilon epi tous ofthalmoys,
verses.translation: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὕπαγε νίψαι εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν τοῦ Σιλωάμ (ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται Ἀπεσταλμένος). ἀπῆλθεν οὖν καὶ ἐνίψατο, καὶ ἦλθεν βλέπων.
verses.translit: kai eipen auto* Upage nipsai eis ten kolymvithran tou Siloam (o ermineyetai Apestalmenos). apelthen oun kai enipsato, kai elthen vlepon.
verses.translation: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

verses.original: οἱ οὖν γείτονες καὶ οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτὸν τὸ πρότερον ὅτι ⸀προσαίτης ἦν ἔλεγον· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ καθήμενος καὶ προσαιτῶν;
verses.translit: oi oun geitones kai oi theorountes auton to proteron oti prosaitis en elegon* Ouh outos estin o kathimenos kai prosaiton;
verses.translation: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

verses.original: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν· ἄλλοι ⸂ἔλεγον· Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ⸃ ὅμοιος αὐτῷ ἐστιν. ἐκεῖνος ἔλεγεν ὅτι Ἐγώ εἰμι.
verses.translit: alloi elegon oti Outos estin* alloi elegon* Ouhi, alla omoios auto estin. ekeinos elegen oti Ego eimi.
verses.translation: Some said, This is he: others said , He is like him: but he said, I am he .

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· ⸀Πῶς ἠνεῴχθησάν σου οἱ ὀφθαλμοί;
verses.translit: elegon oun auto* Pos eneohthisan soy oi ofthalmoi;
verses.translation: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀ἐκεῖνος· ⸂Ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ⸃ λεγόμενος Ἰησοῦς πηλὸν ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐπέχρισέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ εἶπέν μοι ⸀ὅτι Ὕπαγε εἰς ⸀τὸν Σιλωὰμ καὶ νίψαι· ἀπελθὼν ⸀οὖν καὶ νιψάμενος ἀνέβλεψα.
verses.translit: apekrithi ekeinos* O anthropos o legomenos Iisous pilon epoiisen kai epehrisen moy tous ofthalmous kai eipen moi oti Upage eis ton Siloam kai nipsai* apelthon oun kai nipsamenos anevlepsa.
verses.translation: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

verses.original: ⸂καὶ εἶπαν⸃ αὐτῷ· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος; λέγει· Οὐκ οἶδα.
verses.translit: kai eipan auto* Pou estin ekeinos; legei* Ouk oida.
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

verses.original: Ἄγουσιν αὐτὸν πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους τόν ποτε τυφλόν.
verses.translit: Agoysin auton pros tous Farisaioys ton pote tyflon.
verses.translation: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ σάββατον ⸂ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ⸃ τὸν πηλὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀνέῳξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.
verses.translit: en de savvaton en e emera ton pilon epoiisen o Iisous kai aneoxen autou tous ofthalmoys.
verses.translation: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

verses.original: πάλιν οὖν ἠρώτων αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πῶς ἀνέβλεψεν. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πηλὸν ἐπέθηκέν μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς, καὶ ἐνιψάμην, καὶ βλέπω.
verses.translit: palin oun eroton auton kai oi Farisaioi pos anevlepsen. o de eipen autois* Pilon epethiken moy epi tous ofthalmoys, kai enipsamin, kai vlepo.
verses.translation: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων τινές· ⸂Οὐκ ἔστιν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ ὁ ἄνθρωπος⸃, ὅτι τὸ σάββατον οὐ τηρεῖ. ⸀ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλὸς τοιαῦτα σημεῖα ποιεῖν; καὶ σχίσμα ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: elegon oun ek ton Farisaion tines* Ouk estin outos para theou o anthropos, oti to savvaton ou tirei. alloi elegon* Pos dynatai anthropos amartolos toiauta simeia poiein; kai shisma en en autois.
verses.translation: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

verses.original: λέγουσιν ⸀οὖν τῷ τυφλῷ πάλιν· ⸂Τί σὺ⸃ λέγεις περὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ὅτι Προφήτης ἐστίν.
verses.translit: legoysin oun to tyflo palin* Ti su legeis peri autou, oti eneoxen soy tous ofthalmoys; o de eipen oti Profitis estin.
verses.translation: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ⸂ἦν τυφλὸς⸃ καὶ ἀνέβλεψεν, ἕως ὅτου ἐφώνησαν τοὺς γονεῖς αὐτοῦ ⸂τοῦ ἀναβλέψαντος⸃
verses.translit: Ouk episteysan oun oi Ioydaioi peri autou oti en tyflos kai anevlepsen, eos otoy efonisan tous goneis autou tou anavlepsantos
verses.translation: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

verses.original: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτοὺς λέγοντες· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμῶν, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη; πῶς οὖν ⸂βλέπει ἄρτι⸃;
verses.translit: kai erotisan autous legontes* Outos estin o yios umon, on umeis legete oti tyflos egennithi; pos oun vlepei arti;
verses.translation: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν ⸀οὖν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν· Οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη·
verses.translit: apekrithisan oun oi goneis autou kai eipan* Oidamen oti outos estin o yios emon kai oti tyflos egennithi*
verses.translation: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

verses.original: πῶς δὲ νῦν βλέπει οὐκ οἴδαμεν, ἢ τίς ἤνοιξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμεῖς οὐκ οἴδαμεν· ⸂αὐτὸν ἐρωτήσατε, ἡλικίαν ἔχει⸃, αὐτὸς περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λαλήσει.
verses.translit: pos de nun vlepei ouk oidamen, e tis enoixen autou tous ofthalmous emeis ouk oidamen* auton erotisate, elikian ehei, autos peri eaytou lalisei.
verses.translation: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

verses.original: ταῦτα εἶπαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐφοβοῦντο τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, ἤδη γὰρ συνετέθειντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα ἐάν τις αὐτὸν ὁμολογήσῃ χριστόν, ἀποσυνάγωγος γένηται.
verses.translit: tauta eipan oi goneis autou oti efovounto tous Ioydaioys, edi gar synetetheinto oi Ioydaioi ina ean tis auton omologise hriston, aposynagogos genitai.
verses.translation: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπαν ὅτι Ἡλικίαν ἔχει, αὐτὸν ⸀ἐπερωτήσατε.
verses.translit: dia touto oi goneis autou eipan oti Elikian ehei, auton eperotisate.
verses.translation: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

verses.original: Ἐφώνησαν οὖν ⸂τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκ δευτέρου⸃ ὃς ἦν τυφλὸς καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Δὸς δόξαν τῷ θεῷ· ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι ⸂οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος⸃ ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν.
verses.translit: Efonisan oun ton anthropon ek deyteroy os en tyflos kai eipan auto* Dos doxan to theo* emeis oidamen oti outos o anthropos amartolos estin.
verses.translation: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν ⸀ἐκεῖνος· Εἰ ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν οὐκ οἶδα· ἓν οἶδα ὅτι τυφλὸς ὢν ἄρτι βλέπω.
verses.translit: apekrithi oun ekeinos* Ei amartolos estin ouk oida* en oida oti tyflos on arti vlepo.
verses.translation: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

verses.original: εἶπον ⸂οὖν αὐτῷ⸃· Τί ἐποίησέν σοι; πῶς ἤνοιξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς;
verses.translit: eipon oun auto* Ti epoiisen soi; pos enoixen soy tous ofthalmoys;
verses.translation: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν ἤδη καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε· τί πάλιν θέλετε ἀκούειν; μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε αὐτοῦ μαθηταὶ γενέσθαι;
verses.translit: apekrithi autois* Eipon umin edi kai ouk ekoysate* ti palin thelete akoyein; me kai umeis thelete autou mathitai genesthai;
verses.translation: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

verses.original: ⸀ἐλοιδόρησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπον· Σὺ ⸂μαθητὴς εἶ⸃ ἐκείνου, ἡμεῖς δὲ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐσμὲν μαθηταί·
verses.translit: eloidorisan auton kai eipon* Su mathites ei ekeinoy, emeis de tou Moyseos esmen mathitai*
verses.translation: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι Μωϋσεῖ λελάληκεν ὁ θεός, τοῦτον δὲ οὐκ οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν.
verses.translit: emeis oidamen oti Moysei lelaliken o theos, touton de ouk oidamen pothen estin.
verses.translation: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐν ⸂τούτῳ γὰρ τὸ⸃ θαυμαστόν ἐστιν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἐστίν, καὶ ἤνοιξέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.
verses.translit: apekrithi o anthropos kai eipen autois* En toyto gar to thaymaston estin oti umeis ouk oidate pothen estin, kai enoixen moy tous ofthalmoys.
verses.translation: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

verses.original: ⸀οἴδαμεν ὅτι ⸂ἁμαρτωλῶν ὁ θεὸς⸃ οὐκ ἀκούει, ἀλλʼ ἐάν τις θεοσεβὴς ᾖ καὶ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιῇ τούτου ἀκούει.
verses.translit: oidamen oti amartolon o theos ouk akoyei, all' ean tis theoseves e kai to thelima autou poie toytoy akoyei.
verses.translation: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

verses.original: ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἠκούσθη ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν τις ὀφθαλμοὺς τυφλοῦ γεγεννημένου·
verses.translit: ek tou aionos ouk ekoysthi oti eneoxen tis ofthalmous tyflou gegennimenoy*
verses.translation: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

verses.original: εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ, οὐκ ἠδύνατο ποιεῖν οὐδέν.
verses.translit: ei me en outos para theou, ouk edynato poiein ouden.
verses.translation: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἐν ἁμαρτίαις σὺ ἐγεννήθης ὅλος, καὶ σὺ διδάσκεις ἡμᾶς; καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω.
verses.translit: apekrithisan kai eipan auto* En amartiais su egennithis olos, kai su didaskeis emas; kai exevalon auton exo.
verses.translation: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

verses.original: ⸀Ἤκουσεν Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω, καὶ εὑρὼν αὐτὸν ⸀εἶπεν· Σὺ πιστεύεις εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ⸀ἀνθρώπου;
verses.translit: Ekoysen Iisous oti exevalon auton exo, kai euron auton eipen* Su pisteyeis eis ton yion tou anthropoy;
verses.translation: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν· Καὶ τίς ἐστιν, κύριε, ἵνα πιστεύσω εἰς αὐτόν;
verses.translit: apekrithi ekeinos kai eipen* Kai tis estin, kyrie, ina pisteyso eis auton;
verses.translation: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

verses.original: ⸀εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Καὶ ἑώρακας αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετὰ σοῦ ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν.
verses.translit: eipen auto o Iisous* Kai eorakas auton kai o lalon meta sou ekeinos estin.
verses.translation: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἔφη· Πιστεύω, κύριε· καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: o de efi* Pisteyo, kyrie* kai prosekynisen auto.
verses.translation: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰς κρίμα ἐγὼ εἰς τὸν κόσμον τοῦτον ἦλθον, ἵνα οἱ μὴ βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ οἱ βλέποντες τυφλοὶ γένωνται.
verses.translit: kai eipen o Iisous* Eis krima ego eis ton kosmon touton elthon, ina oi me vlepontes vleposin kai oi vlepontes tyfloi genontai.
verses.translation: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

verses.original: ⸀ἤκουσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ταῦτα οἱ ⸂μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὄντες⸃, καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ ἡμεῖς τυφλοί ἐσμεν;
verses.translit: ekoysan ek ton Farisaion tauta oi met' autou ontes, kai eipon auto* Me kai emeis tyfloi esmen;
verses.translation: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

verses.original: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ τυφλοὶ ἦτε, οὐκ ἂν εἴχετε ἁμαρτίαν· νῦν δὲ λέγετε ὅτι Βλέπομεν· ⸀ἡ ἁμαρτία ὑμῶν μένει.
verses.translit: eipen autois o Iisous* Ei tyfloi ete, ouk an eihete amartian* nun de legete oti Vlepomen* e amartia umon menei.
verses.translation: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν ἐκεῖνος κλέπτης ἐστὶν καὶ λῃστής·
verses.translit: Amen amen lego umin, o me eiserhomenos dia tes thyras eis ten aulen ton provaton alla anavainon allahothen ekeinos kleptis estin kai lestis*
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ποιμήν ἐστιν τῶν προβάτων.
verses.translit: o de eiserhomenos dia tes thyras poimin estin ton provaton.
verses.translation: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.original: τούτῳ ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούει καὶ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα ⸀φωνεῖ κατʼ ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά.
verses.translit: toyto o thyroros anoigei, kai ta provata tes fones autou akoyei kai ta idia provata fonei kat' onoma kai exagei auta.
verses.translation: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

verses.original: ⸀ὅταν τὰ ἴδια ⸀πάντα ἐκβάλῃ, ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν πορεύεται, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῷ ἀκολουθεῖ, ὅτι οἴδασιν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: otan ta idia panta ekvale, emprosthen auton poreyetai, kai ta provata auto akoloythei, oti oidasin ten fonen autou*
verses.translation: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

verses.original: ἀλλοτρίῳ δὲ οὐ μὴ ⸀ἀκολουθήσουσιν ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασι τῶν ἀλλοτρίων τὴν φωνήν.
verses.translit: allotrio de ou me akoloythisoysin alla feyxontai ap' autou, oti ouk oidasi ton allotrion ten fonin.
verses.translation: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

verses.original: ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ⸀ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: taytin ten paroimian eipen autois o Iisous* ekeinoi de ouk egnosan tina en a elalei autois.
verses.translation: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν ⸀αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ⸀ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων.
verses.translit: Eipen oun palin autois o Iisous* Amen amen lego umin oti ego eimi e thyra ton provaton.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.original: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον ⸂πρὸ ἐμοῦ⸃ κλέπται εἰσὶν καὶ λῃσταί· ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν τὰ πρόβατα.
verses.translit: pantes osoi elthon pro emou kleptai eisin kai lestai* all' ouk ekoysan auton ta provata.
verses.translation: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα· διʼ ἐμοῦ ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ νομὴν εὑρήσει.
verses.translit: ego eimi e thyra* di' emou ean tis eiselthe sothisetai kai eiseleysetai kai exeleysetai kai nomen eurisei.
verses.translation: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

verses.original: ὁ κλέπτης οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ· ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν.
verses.translit: o kleptis ouk erhetai ei me ina klepse kai thyse kai apolese* ego elthon ina zoen ehosin kai perisson ehosin.
verses.translation: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός· ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίθησιν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων·
verses.translit: Ego eimi o poimen o kalos* o poimen o kalos ten psyhen autou tithisin uper ton provaton*
verses.translation: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

verses.original: ὁ ⸀μισθωτὸς καὶ οὐκ ὢν ποιμήν, οὗ οὐκ ⸀ἔστιν τὰ πρόβατα ἴδια, θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει— καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ ⸀σκορπίζει—
verses.translit: o misthotos kai ouk on poimin, ou ouk estin ta provata idia, theorei ton lykon erhomenon kai afiisin ta provata kai feygei-- kai o lykos arpazei auta kai skorpizei--
verses.translation: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

verses.original: ⸀ὅτι μισθωτός ἐστιν καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων.
verses.translit: oti misthotos estin kai ou melei auto peri ton provaton.
verses.translation: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ καὶ ⸂γινώσκουσί με τὰ ἐμά⸃,
verses.translit: ego eimi o poimen o kalos, kai ginosko ta ema kai ginoskoysi me ta ema,
verses.translation: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep , and am known of mine.

verses.original: καθὼς γινώσκει με ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν πατέρα, καὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου τίθημι ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων.
verses.translit: kathos ginoskei me o pater kago ginosko ton patera, kai ten psyhin moy tithimi uper ton provaton.
verses.translation: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

verses.original: καὶ ἄλλα πρόβατα ἔχω ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς αὐλῆς ταύτης· κἀκεῖνα ⸂δεῖ με⸃ ἀγαγεῖν, καὶ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούσουσιν, καὶ ⸀γενήσονται μία ποίμνη, εἷς ποιμήν.
verses.translit: kai alla provata eho a ouk estin ek tes aules taytis* kakeina dei me agagein, kai tes fones moy akoysoysin, kai genisontai mia poimni, eis poimin.
verses.translation: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτό ⸂με ὁ πατὴρ⸃ ἀγαπᾷ ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἵνα πάλιν λάβω αὐτήν.
verses.translit: dia touto me o pater agapa oti ego tithimi ten psyhin moy, ina palin lavo autin.
verses.translation: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς ⸀αἴρει αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ. ἐξουσίαν ἔχω θεῖναι αὐτήν, καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω πάλιν λαβεῖν αὐτήν· ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου.
verses.translit: oudeis airei auten ap' emou, all' ego tithimi auten ap' emaytou. exoysian eho theinai autin, kai exoysian eho palin lavein autin* taytin ten entolen elavon para tou patros moy.
verses.translation: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

verses.original: ⸀Σχίσμα πάλιν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους.
verses.translit: Shisma palin egeneto en tois Ioydaiois dia tous logoys toytoys.
verses.translation: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

verses.original: ἔλεγον δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν· Δαιμόνιον ἔχει καὶ μαίνεται· τί αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε;
verses.translit: elegon de polloi ex auton* Daimonion ehei kai mainetai* ti autou akoyete;
verses.translation: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

verses.original: ⸀ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οὐκ ἔστιν δαιμονιζομένου· μὴ δαιμόνιον δύναται τυφλῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς ⸀ἀνοῖξαι;
verses.translit: alloi elegon* Tauta ta Rimata ouk estin daimonizomenoy* me daimonion dynatai tyflon ofthalmous anoixai;
verses.translation: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

verses.original: Ἐγένετο ⸀τότε τὰ ἐγκαίνια ἐν ⸀τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις· ⸀χειμὼν ἦν,
verses.translit: Egeneto tote ta egkainia en tois Ierosolymois* heimon en,
verses.translation: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

verses.original: καὶ περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ στοᾷ ⸀τοῦ Σολομῶνος.
verses.translit: kai periepatei o Iisous en to iero en te stoa tou Solomonos.
verses.translation: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

verses.original: ἐκύκλωσαν οὖν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ· Ἕως πότε τὴν ψυχὴν ἡμῶν αἴρεις; εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός, εἰπὲ ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ.
verses.translit: ekyklosan oun auton oi Ioydaioi kai elegon auto* Eos pote ten psyhen emon aireis; ei su ei o hristos, eipe emin parrisia.
verses.translation: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε· τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.translit: apekrithi autois o Iisous* Eipon umin kai ou pisteyete* ta erga a ego poio en to onomati tou patros moy tauta martyrei peri emou*
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε, ⸂ὅτι οὐκ⸃ ἐστὲ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων τῶν ⸀ἐμῶν.
verses.translit: alla umeis ou pisteyete, oti ouk este ek ton provaton ton emon.
verses.translation: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

verses.original: τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἐμὰ τῆς φωνῆς μου ⸀ἀκούουσιν, κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι,
verses.translit: ta provata ta ema tes fones moy akoyoysin, kago ginosko auta, kai akoloythousin moi,
verses.translation: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

verses.original: κἀγὼ ⸂δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον⸃, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ οὐχ ἁρπάσει τις αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς χειρός μου.
verses.translit: kago didomi autois zoen aionion, kai ou me apolontai eis ton aiona, kai ouh arpasei tis auta ek tes heiros moy.
verses.translation: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

verses.original: ὁ πατήρ μου ⸀ὃ δέδωκέν ⸀μοι ⸂πάντων μεῖζων⸃ ἐστίν, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ ⸀πατρός.
verses.translit: o patir moy o dedoken moi panton meizon estin, kai oudeis dynatai arpazein ek tes heiros tou patros.
verses.translation: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

verses.original: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἕν ἐσμεν.
verses.translit: ego kai o pater en esmen.
verses.translation: I and my Father are one.

verses.original: Ἐβάστασαν ⸀οὖν πάλιν λίθους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: Evastasan oun palin lithoys oi Ioydaioi ina lithasosin auton.
verses.translation: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πολλὰ ⸂ἔργα καλὰ ἔδειξα ὑμῖν⸃ ἐκ τοῦ ⸀πατρός· διὰ ποῖον αὐτῶν ἔργον ⸂ἐμὲ λιθάζετε⸃;
verses.translit: apekrithi autois o Iisous* Polla erga kala edeixa umin ek tou patros* dia poion auton ergon eme lithazete;
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ ⸀Ἰουδαῖοι· Περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου οὐ λιθάζομέν σε ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας, καὶ ὅτι σὺ ἄνθρωπος ὢν ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν θεόν.
verses.translit: apekrithisan auto oi Ioydaioi* Peri kalou ergoy ou lithazomen se alla peri vlasfimias, kai oti su anthropos on poieis seayton theon.
verses.translation: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὑμῶν ⸀ὅτι Ἐγὼ εἶπα· Θεοί ἐστε;
verses.translit: apekrithi autois o Iisous* Ouk estin gegrammenon en to nomo umon oti Ego eipa* Theoi este;
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

verses.original: εἰ ἐκείνους εἶπεν θεοὺς πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι ἡ γραφή,
verses.translit: ei ekeinoys eipen theous pros ous o logos tou theou egeneto, kai ou dynatai lythenai e grafi,
verses.translation: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

verses.original: ὃν ὁ πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Βλασφημεῖς, ὅτι εἶπον· Υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι;
verses.translit: on o pater egiasen kai apesteilen eis ton kosmon umeis legete oti Vlasfimeis, oti eipon* Yios tou theou eimi;
verses.translation: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

verses.original: εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρός μου, μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι·
verses.translit: ei ou poio ta erga tou patros moy, me pisteyete moi*
verses.translation: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ποιῶ, κἂν ἐμοὶ μὴ πιστεύητε τοῖς ἔργοις ⸀πιστεύετε, ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ ⸀γινώσκητε ὅτι ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ ἐν ⸂τῷ πατρί⸃.
verses.translit: ei de poio, kan emoi me pisteyite tois ergois pisteyete, ina gnote kai ginoskite oti en emoi o pater kago en to patri.
verses.translation: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

verses.original: ἐζήτουν οὖν ⸂πάλιν αὐτὸν⸃ πιάσαι· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: ezitoyn oun palin auton piasai* kai exelthen ek tes heiros auton.
verses.translation: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἦν Ἰωάννης τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων, καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ.
verses.translit: Kai apelthen palin peran tou Iordanoy eis ton topon opoy en Ioannis to proton vaptizon, kai emeinen ekei.
verses.translation: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν σημεῖον ἐποίησεν οὐδέν, πάντα δὲ ὅσα εἶπεν Ἰωάννης περὶ τούτου ἀληθῆ ἦν.
verses.translit: kai polloi elthon pros auton kai elegon oti Ioannis men simeion epoiisen ouden, panta de osa eipen Ioannis peri toytoy alithe en.
verses.translation: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ⸃.
verses.translit: kai polloi episteysan eis auton ekei.
verses.translation: And many believed on him there.

verses.original: Ἦν δέ τις ἀσθενῶν, Λάζαρος ἀπὸ Βηθανίας ἐκ τῆς κώμης Μαρίας καὶ Μάρθας τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: En de tis asthenon, Lazaros apo Vithanias ek tes komis Marias kai Marthas tes adelfes autes.
verses.translation: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ⸀Μαριὰμ ἡ ἀλείψασα τὸν κύριον μύρῳ καὶ ἐκμάξασα τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς, ἧς ὁ ἀδελφὸς Λάζαρος ἠσθένει.
verses.translit: en de Mariam e aleipsasa ton kyrion myro kai ekmaxasa tous podas autou tais thrixin autes, es o adelfos Lazaros esthenei.
verses.translation: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

verses.original: ἀπέστειλαν οὖν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσαι· Κύριε, ἴδε ὃν φιλεῖς ἀσθενεῖ.
verses.translit: apesteilan oun ai adelfai pros auton legoysai* Kyrie, ide on fileis asthenei.
verses.translation: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Αὕτη ἡ ἀσθένεια οὐκ ἔστιν πρὸς θάνατον ἀλλʼ ὑπὲρ τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ διʼ αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: akoysas de o Iisous eipen* Auti e astheneia ouk estin pros thanaton all' uper tes doxis tou theou ina doxasthe o yios tou theou di' autes.
verses.translation: When Jesus heard that , he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

verses.original: ἠγάπα δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον.
verses.translit: egapa de o Iisous ten Marthan kai ten adelfen autes kai ton Lazaron.
verses.translation: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.original: ὡς οὖν ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἀσθενεῖ, τότε μὲν ἔμεινεν ἐν ᾧ ἦν τόπῳ δύο ἡμέρας·
verses.translit: os oun ekoysen oti asthenei, tote men emeinen en o en topo dyo emeras*
verses.translation: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

verses.original: ἔπειτα μετὰ τοῦτο λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς· Ἄγωμεν εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν πάλιν.
verses.translit: epeita meta touto legei tois mathitais* Agomen eis ten Ioydaian palin.
verses.translation: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί· Ῥαββί, νῦν ἐζήτουν σε λιθάσαι οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι, καὶ πάλιν ὑπάγεις ἐκεῖ;
verses.translit: legoysin auto oi mathitai* Ravvi, nun ezitoyn se lithasai oi Ioydaioi, kai palin upageis ekei;
verses.translation: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὐχὶ δώδεκα ⸂ὧραί εἰσιν⸃ τῆς ἡμέρας; ἐάν τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, οὐ προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου τούτου βλέπει·
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous* Ouhi dodeka orai eisin tes emeras; ean tis peripate en te emera, ou proskoptei, oti to fos tou kosmoy toytoy vlepei*
verses.translation: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

verses.original: ἐὰν δέ τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ νυκτί, προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: ean de tis peripate en te nykti, proskoptei, oti to fos ouk estin en auto.
verses.translation: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

verses.original: ταῦτα εἶπεν, καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο λέγει αὐτοῖς· Λάζαρος ὁ φίλος ἡμῶν κεκοίμηται, ἀλλὰ πορεύομαι ἵνα ἐξυπνίσω αὐτόν.
verses.translit: tauta eipen, kai meta touto legei autois* Lazaros o filos emon kekoimitai, alla poreyomai ina exypniso auton.
verses.translation: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

verses.original: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ ⸀αὐτῷ· Κύριε, εἰ κεκοίμηται σωθήσεται.
verses.translit: eipan oun oi mathitai auto* Kyrie, ei kekoimitai sothisetai.
verses.translation: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

verses.original: εἰρήκει δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς περὶ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ. ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἔδοξαν ὅτι περὶ τῆς κοιμήσεως τοῦ ὕπνου λέγει.
verses.translit: eirikei de o Iisous peri tou thanatoy autou. ekeinoi de edoxan oti peri tes koimiseos tou upnoy legei.
verses.translation: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

verses.original: τότε οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς παρρησίᾳ· Λάζαρος ἀπέθανεν,
verses.translit: tote oun eipen autois o Iisous parrisia* Lazaros apethanen,
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

verses.original: καὶ χαίρω διʼ ὑμᾶς, ἵνα πιστεύσητε, ὅτι οὐκ ἤμην ἐκεῖ· ἀλλὰ ἄγωμεν πρὸς αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai hairo di' umas, ina pisteysite, oti ouk emin ekei* alla agomen pros auton.
verses.translation: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος τοῖς συμμαθηταῖς· Ἄγωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἀποθάνωμεν μετʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: eipen oun Thomas o legomenos Didymos tois symmathitais* Agomen kai emeis ina apothanomen met' autou.
verses.translation: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

verses.original: Ἐλθὼν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὗρεν αὐτὸν τέσσαρας ⸂ἤδη ἡμέρας⸃ ἔχοντα ἐν τῷ μνημείῳ.
verses.translit: Elthon oun o Iisous euren auton tessaras edi emeras ehonta en to mnimeio.
verses.translation: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ⸀ἡ Βηθανία ἐγγὺς τῶν Ἱεροσολύμων ὡς ἀπὸ σταδίων δεκαπέντε.
verses.translit: en de e Vithania eggus ton Ierosolymon os apo stadion dekapente.
verses.translation: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

verses.original: ⸂πολλοὶ δὲ⸃ ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐληλύθεισαν πρὸς ⸀τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ ⸀Μαριὰμ ἵνα παραμυθήσωνται αὐτὰς περὶ τοῦ ⸀ἀδελφοῦ.
verses.translit: polloi de ek ton Ioydaion elilytheisan pros ten Marthan kai Mariam ina paramythisontai autas peri tou adelfou.
verses.translation: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

verses.original: ἡ οὖν Μάρθα ὡς ἤκουσεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἔρχεται ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ· ⸀Μαρία δὲ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἐκαθέζετο.
verses.translit: e oun Martha os ekoysen oti Iisous erhetai upintisen auto* Maria de en to oiko ekathezeto.
verses.translation: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ⸀ἡ Μάρθα πρὸς ⸀τὸν Ἰησοῦν· Κύριε, εἰ ἦς ὧδε ⸂οὐκ ἂν ἀπέθανεν ὁ ἀδελφός μου⸃·
verses.translit: eipen oun e Martha pros ton Iisoun* Kyrie, ei es ode ouk an apethanen o adelfos moy*
verses.translation: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

verses.original: ⸀καὶ νῦν οἶδα ὅτι ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσῃ τὸν θεὸν δώσει σοι ὁ θεός.
verses.translit: kai nun oida oti osa an aitise ton theon dosei soi o theos.
verses.translation: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀναστήσεται ὁ ἀδελφός σου.
verses.translit: legei aute o Iisous* Anastisetai o adelfos soy.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ἡ Μάρθα· Οἶδα ὅτι ἀναστήσεται ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.translit: legei auto e Martha* Oida oti anastisetai en te anastasei en te eshate emera.
verses.translation: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

verses.original: εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή· ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ κἂν ἀποθάνῃ ζήσεται,
verses.translit: eipen aute o Iisous* Ego eimi e anastasis kai e zoi* o pisteyon eis eme kan apothane zisetai,
verses.translation: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ζῶν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· πιστεύεις τοῦτο;
verses.translit: kai pas o zon kai pisteyon eis eme ou me apothane eis ton aiona* pisteyeis touto;
verses.translation: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ· Ναί, κύριε· ἐγὼ πεπίστευκα ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐρχόμενος.
verses.translit: legei auto* Nai, kyrie* ego pepisteyka oti su ei o hristos o yios tou theou o eis ton kosmon erhomenos.
verses.translation: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸀τοῦτο εἰποῦσα ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἐφώνησεν ⸀Μαριὰμ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῆς λάθρᾳ εἰποῦσα· Ὁ διδάσκαλος πάρεστιν καὶ φωνεῖ σε.
verses.translit: Kai touto eipousa apelthen kai efonisen Mariam ten adelfen autes lathra eipousa* O didaskalos parestin kai fonei se.
verses.translation: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

verses.original: ἐκείνη ⸀δὲ ὡς ἤκουσεν ⸀ἠγέρθη ταχὺ καὶ ⸀ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν·
verses.translit: ekeini de os ekoysen egerthi tahu kai erheto pros auton*
verses.translation: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly, and came unto him.

verses.original: οὔπω δὲ ἐληλύθει ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν κώμην, ἀλλʼ ἦν ⸀ἔτι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ἡ Μάρθα.
verses.translit: oupo de elilythei o Iisous eis ten komin, all' en eti en to topo opoy upintisen auto e Martha.
verses.translation: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

verses.original: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι οἱ ὄντες μετʼ αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ παραμυθούμενοι αὐτήν, ἰδόντες τὴν ⸀Μαριὰμ ὅτι ταχέως ἀνέστη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν, ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῇ ⸀δόξαντες ὅτι ὑπάγει εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον ἵνα κλαύσῃ ἐκεῖ.
verses.translit: oi oun Ioydaioi oi ontes met' autes en te oikia kai paramythoymenoi autin, idontes ten Mariam oti taheos anesti kai exelthen, ekoloythisan aute doxantes oti upagei eis to mnimeion ina klayse ekei.
