verses.translation: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

verses.original: ἡ οὖν ⸀Μαριὰμ ὡς ἦλθεν ὅπου ⸀ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἔπεσεν αὐτοῦ ⸀πρὸς τοὺς πόδας, λέγουσα αὐτῷ· Κύριε, εἰ ἦς ὧδε οὐκ ἄν ⸂μου ἀπέθανεν⸃ ὁ ἀδελφός.
verses.translit: e oun Mariam os elthen opoy en Iisous idousa auton epesen autou pros tous podas, legoysa auto* Kyrie, ei es ode ouk an moy apethanen o adelfos.
verses.translation: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν ὡς εἶδεν αὐτὴν κλαίουσαν καὶ τοὺς συνελθόντας αὐτῇ Ἰουδαίους κλαίοντας ἐνεβριμήσατο τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐτάραξεν ἑαυτόν,
verses.translit: Iisous oun os eiden auten klaioysan kai tous synelthontas aute Ioydaioys klaiontas enevrimisato to pneymati kai etaraxen eayton,
verses.translation: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν· Ποῦ τεθείκατε αὐτόν; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε.
verses.translit: kai eipen* Pou tetheikate auton; legoysin auto* Kyrie, erhoy kai ide.
verses.translation: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

verses.original: ἐδάκρυσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.
verses.translit: edakrysen o Iisous.
verses.translation: Jesus wept.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Ἴδε πῶς ἐφίλει αὐτόν.
verses.translit: elegon oun oi Ioydaioi* Ide pos efilei auton.
verses.translation: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπαν· Οὐκ ἐδύνατο οὗτος ὁ ἀνοίξας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ τυφλοῦ ποιῆσαι ἵνα καὶ οὗτος μὴ ἀποθάνῃ;
verses.translit: tines de ex auton eipan* Ouk edynato outos o anoixas tous ofthalmous tou tyflou poiesai ina kai outos me apothane;
verses.translation: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν πάλιν ἐμβριμώμενος ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἔρχεται εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον· ἦν δὲ σπήλαιον, καὶ λίθος ἐπέκειτο ἐπʼ αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: Iisous oun palin emvrimomenos en eayto erhetai eis to mnimeion* en de spilaion, kai lithos epekeito ep' auto.
verses.translation: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

verses.original: λέγει ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρατε τὸν λίθον. λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ ἀδελφὴ τοῦ ⸀τετελευτηκότος Μάρθα· Κύριε, ἤδη ὄζει, τεταρταῖος γάρ ἐστιν.
verses.translit: legei o Iisous* Arate ton lithon. legei auto e adelfe tou teteleytikotos Martha* Kyrie, edi ozei, tetartaios gar estin.
verses.translation: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ εἶπόν σοι ὅτι ἐὰν πιστεύσῃς ⸀ὄψῃ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ;
verses.translit: legei aute o Iisous* Ouk eipon soi oti ean pisteyses opse ten doxan tou theou;
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

verses.original: ἦραν οὖν τὸν ⸀λίθον. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἦρεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἄνω καὶ εἶπεν· Πάτερ, εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι ἤκουσάς μου,
verses.translit: eran oun ton lithon. o de Iisous eren tous ofthalmous ano kai eipen* Pater, euharisto soi oti ekoysas moy,
verses.translation: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ᾔδειν ὅτι πάντοτέ μου ἀκούεις· ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον τὸν περιεστῶτα εἶπον, ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
verses.translit: ego de edein oti pantote moy akoyeis* alla dia ton ohlon ton periestota eipon, ina pisteysosin oti sy me apesteilas.
verses.translation: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐκραύγασεν· Λάζαρε, δεῦρο ἔξω.
verses.translit: kai tauta eipon fone megale ekraygasen* Lazare, deuro exo.
verses.translation: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

verses.original: ⸀ἐξῆλθεν ὁ τεθνηκὼς δεδεμένος τοὺς πόδας καὶ τὰς χεῖρας κειρίαις, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ σουδαρίῳ περιεδέδετο. λέγει ⸂αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς⸃· Λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἄφετε ⸀αὐτὸν ὑπάγειν.
verses.translit: exelthen o tethnikos dedemenos tous podas kai tas heiras keiriais, kai e opsis autou soydario periededeto. legei autois o Iisous* Lysate auton kai afete auton upagein.
verses.translation: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

verses.original: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, οἱ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τὴν ⸀Μαριὰμ καὶ θεασάμενοι ⸀ἃ ⸀ἐποίησεν, ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν·
verses.translit: Polloi oun ek ton Ioydaion, oi elthontes pros ten Mariam kai theasamenoi a epoiisen, episteysan eis auton*
verses.translation: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπῆλθον πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς ἃ ⸀ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς.
verses.translit: tines de ex auton apelthon pros tous Farisaioys kai eipan autois a epoiisen Iisous.
verses.translation: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

verses.original: συνήγαγον οὖν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συνέδριον, καὶ ἔλεγον· Τί ποιοῦμεν ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος πολλὰ ⸂ποιεῖ σημεῖα⸃;
verses.translit: synigagon oun oi arhiereis kai oi Farisaioi synedrion, kai elegon* Ti poioumen oti outos o anthropos polla poiei simeia;
verses.translation: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

verses.original: ἐὰν ἀφῶμεν αὐτὸν οὕτως, πάντες πιστεύσουσιν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ἐλεύσονται οἱ Ῥωμαῖοι καὶ ἀροῦσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν τόπον καὶ τὸ ἔθνος.
verses.translit: ean afomen auton outos, pantes pisteysoysin eis auton, kai eleysontai oi Romaioi kai arousin emon kai ton topon kai to ethnos.
verses.translation: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

verses.original: εἷς δέ τις ἐξ αὐτῶν Καϊάφας, ἀρχιερεὺς ὢν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε οὐδέν,
verses.translit: eis de tis ex auton Kaiafas, arhiereus on tou eniaytou ekeinoy, eipen autois* Umeis ouk oidate ouden,
verses.translation: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

verses.original: οὐδὲ ⸀λογίζεσθε ὅτι συμφέρει ⸀ὑμῖν ἵνα εἷς ἄνθρωπος ἀποθάνῃ ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ ἔθνος ἀπόληται.
verses.translit: oude logizesthe oti symferei umin ina eis anthropos apothane uper tou laou kai me olon to ethnos apolitai.
verses.translation: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ οὐκ εἶπεν, ἀλλὰ ἀρχιερεὺς ὢν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου ἐπροφήτευσεν ὅτι ἔμελλεν Ἰησοῦς ἀποθνῄσκειν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους,
verses.translit: touto de af' eaytou ouk eipen, alla arhiereus on tou eniaytou ekeinoy eprofiteysen oti emellen Iisous apothneskein uper tou ethnoys,
verses.translation: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους μόνον, ἀλλʼ ἵνα καὶ τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ διεσκορπισμένα συναγάγῃ εἰς ἕν.
verses.translit: kai ouh uper tou ethnoys monon, all' ina kai ta tekna tou theou ta dieskorpismena synagage eis en.
verses.translation: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

verses.original: ἀπʼ ἐκείνης οὖν τῆς ἡμέρας ⸀ἐβουλεύσαντο ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: ap' ekeinis oun tes emeras evoyleysanto ina apokteinosin auton.
verses.translation: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

verses.original: ⸂Ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς⸃ οὐκέτι παρρησίᾳ περιεπάτει ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν χώραν ἐγγὺς τῆς ἐρήμου, εἰς Ἐφραὶμ λεγομένην πόλιν, κἀκεῖ ⸀ἔμεινεν μετὰ τῶν ⸀μαθητῶν.
verses.translit: O oun Iisous ouketi parrisia periepatei en tois Ioydaiois, alla apelthen ekeithen eis ten horan eggus tes erimoy, eis Efraim legomenin polin, kakei emeinen meta ton mathiton.
verses.translation: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβησαν πολλοὶ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐκ τῆς χώρας πρὸ τοῦ πάσχα ἵνα ἁγνίσωσιν ἑαυτούς.
verses.translit: En de eggus to pasha ton Ioydaion, kai anevisan polloi eis Ierosolyma ek tes horas pro tou pasha ina agnisosin eaytoys.
verses.translation: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

verses.original: ἐζήτουν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔλεγον μετʼ ἀλλήλων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἑστηκότες· Τί δοκεῖ ὑμῖν; ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν;
verses.translit: ezitoyn oun ton Iisoun kai elegon met' allilon en to iero estikotes* Ti dokei umin; oti ou me elthe eis ten eortin;
verses.translation: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

verses.original: δεδώκεισαν ⸀δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ⸀ἐντολὰς ἵνα ἐάν τις γνῷ ποῦ ἐστιν μηνύσῃ, ὅπως πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: dedokeisan de oi arhiereis kai oi Farisaioi entolas ina ean tis gno pou estin minyse, opos piasosin auton.
verses.translation: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it , that they might take him.

verses.original: Ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς πρὸ ἓξ ἡμερῶν τοῦ πάσχα ἦλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν, ὅπου ἦν ⸀Λάζαρος, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν ⸀Ἰησοῦς.
verses.translit: O oun Iisous pro ex emeron tou pasha elthen eis Vithanian, opoy en Lazaros, on egeiren ek nekron Iisous.
verses.translation: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

verses.original: ἐποίησαν οὖν αὐτῷ δεῖπνον ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἡ Μάρθα διηκόνει, ὁ δὲ Λάζαρος εἷς ἦν ⸀ἐκ τῶν ἀνακειμένων σὺν αὐτῷ·
verses.translit: epoiisan oun auto deipnon ekei, kai e Martha diikonei, o de Lazaros eis en ek ton anakeimenon sun auto*
verses.translation: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

verses.original: ἡ οὖν ⸀Μαριὰμ λαβοῦσα λίτραν μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτίμου ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ· ἡ δὲ οἰκία ἐπληρώθη ἐκ τῆς ὀσμῆς τοῦ μύρου.
verses.translit: e oun Mariam lavousa litran myroy nardoy pistikes polytimoy eleipsen tous podas tou Iisou kai exemaxen tais thrixin autes tous podas autou* e de oikia eplirothi ek tes osmes tou myroy.
verses.translation: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

verses.original: λέγει ⸀δὲ ⸂Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ⸃, ὁ μέλλων αὐτὸν παραδιδόναι·
verses.translit: legei de Ioydas o Iskariotis eis ton mathiton autou, o mellon auton paradidonai*
verses.translation: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , which should betray him,

verses.original: Διὰ τί τοῦτο τὸ μύρον οὐκ ἐπράθη τριακοσίων δηναρίων καὶ ἐδόθη πτωχοῖς;
verses.translit: Dia ti touto to myron ouk eprathi triakosion dinarion kai edothi ptohois;
verses.translation: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ τοῦτο οὐχ ὅτι περὶ τῶν πτωχῶν ἔμελεν αὐτῷ, ἀλλʼ ὅτι κλέπτης ἦν καὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον ⸀ἔχων τὰ βαλλόμενα ἐβάσταζεν.
verses.translit: eipen de touto ouh oti peri ton ptohon emelen auto, all' oti kleptis en kai to glossokomon ehon ta vallomena evastazen.
verses.translation: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἄφες αὐτήν, ⸀ἵνα εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνταφιασμοῦ μου ⸀τηρήσῃ αὐτό·
verses.translit: eipen oun o Iisous* Afes autin, ina eis ten emeran tou entafiasmou moy tirise auto*
verses.translation: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

verses.original: τοὺς πτωχοὺς γὰρ πάντοτε ἔχετε μεθʼ ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.
verses.translit: tous ptohous gar pantote ehete meth' eayton, eme de ou pantote ehete.
verses.translation: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

verses.original: Ἔγνω ⸀οὖν ὄχλος πολὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐστιν, καὶ ἦλθον οὐ διὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον, ἀλλʼ ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἴδωσιν ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν.
verses.translit: Egno oun ohlos polus ek ton Ioydaion oti ekei estin, kai elthon ou dia ton Iisoun monon, all' ina kai ton Lazaron idosin on egeiren ek nekron.
verses.translation: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.original: ἐβουλεύσαντο δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἀποκτείνωσιν,
verses.translit: evoyleysanto de oi arhiereis ina kai ton Lazaron apokteinosin,
verses.translation: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

verses.original: ὅτι πολλοὶ διʼ αὐτὸν ὑπῆγον τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐπίστευον εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.translit: oti polloi di' auton upegon ton Ioydaion kai episteyon eis ton Iisoun.
verses.translation: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ⸀ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἔρχεται ⸁ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα,
verses.translit: Te epayrion o ohlos polus o elthon eis ten eortin, akoysantes oti erhetai o Iisous eis Ierosolyma,
verses.translation: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.original: ἔλαβον τὰ βαΐα τῶν φοινίκων καὶ ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν αὐτῷ, καὶ ⸀ἐκραύγαζον· Ὡσαννά, εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου, ⸂καὶ ὁ⸃ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: elavon ta vaIa ton foinikon kai exelthon eis upantisin auto, kai ekraygazon* Osanna, eulogimenos o erhomenos en onomati kyrioy, kai o vasileus tou Israil.
verses.translation: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.original: εὑρὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὀνάριον ἐκάθισεν ἐπʼ αὐτό, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον·
verses.translit: euron de o Iisous onarion ekathisen ep' auto, kathos estin gegrammenon*
verses.translation: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

verses.original: Μὴ φοβοῦ, θυγάτηρ Σιών· ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεται, καθήμενος ἐπὶ πῶλον ὄνου.
verses.translit: Me fovou, thygatir Sion* idou o vasileys soy erhetai, kathimenos epi polon onoy.
verses.translation: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

verses.original: ⸀ταῦτα οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ⸂αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ⸃ τὸ πρῶτον, ἀλλʼ ὅτε ἐδοξάσθη Ἰησοῦς τότε ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ταῦτα ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ γεγραμμένα καὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: tauta ouk egnosan autou oi mathitai to proton, all' ote edoxasthi Iisous tote emnisthisan oti tauta en ep' auto gegrammena kai tauta epoiisan auto.
verses.translation: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

verses.original: ἐμαρτύρει οὖν ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ὢν μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὅτε τὸν Λάζαρον ἐφώνησεν ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν.
verses.translit: emartyrei oun o ohlos o on met' autou ote ton Lazaron efonisen ek tou mnimeioy kai egeiren auton ek nekron.
verses.translation: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ⸀καὶ ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι ⸀ἤκουσαν τοῦτο αὐτὸν πεποιηκέναι τὸ σημεῖον.
verses.translit: dia touto kai upintisen auto o ohlos oti ekoysan touto auton pepoiikenai to simeion.
verses.translation: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

verses.original: οἱ οὖν Φαρισαῖοι εἶπαν πρὸς ἑαυτούς· Θεωρεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ ὠφελεῖτε οὐδέν· ἴδε ὁ ⸀κόσμος ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν.
verses.translit: oi oun Farisaioi eipan pros eaytoys* Theoreite oti ouk ofeleite ouden* ide o kosmos opiso autou apelthen.
verses.translation: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ ⸂Ἕλληνές τινες⸃ ἐκ τῶν ἀναβαινόντων ἵνα προσκυνήσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ·
verses.translit: Esan de Ellines tines ek ton anavainonton ina proskynisosin en te eorte*
verses.translation: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

verses.original: οὗτοι οὖν προσῆλθον Φιλίππῳ τῷ ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Κύριε, θέλομεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδεῖν.
verses.translit: outoi oun proselthon Filippo to apo Vithsaida tes Galilaias, kai eroton auton legontes* Kyrie, thelomen ton Iisoun idein.
verses.translation: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

verses.original: ἔρχεται ⸀ὁ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἀνδρέᾳ· ⸀ἔρχεται Ἀνδρέας καὶ Φίλιππος ⸀καὶ λέγουσιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: erhetai o Filippos kai legei to Andrea* erhetai Andreas kai Filippos kai legoysin to Iisou.
verses.translation: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ⸀ἀποκρίνεται αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.
verses.translit: o de Iisous apokrinetai autois legon* Elilythen e ora ina doxasthe o yios tou anthropoy.
verses.translation: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ ὁ κόκκος τοῦ σίτου πεσὼν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἀποθάνῃ, αὐτὸς μόνος μένει· ἐὰν δὲ ἀποθάνῃ, πολὺν καρπὸν φέρει.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, ean me o kokkos tou sitoy peson eis ten gen apothane, autos monos menei* ean de apothane, polun karpon ferei.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

verses.original: ὁ φιλῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ⸀ἀπολλύει αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ μισῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον φυλάξει αὐτήν.
verses.translit: o filon ten psyhen autou apollyei autin, kai o mison ten psyhen autou en to kosmo toyto eis zoen aionion fylaxei autin.
verses.translation: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

verses.original: ἐὰν ἐμοί ⸂τις διακονῇ⸃ ἐμοὶ ἀκολουθείτω, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἐκεῖ καὶ ὁ διάκονος ὁ ἐμὸς ἔσται· ⸀ἐάν τις ἐμοὶ διακονῇ τιμήσει αὐτὸν ὁ πατήρ.
verses.translit: ean emoi tis diakone emoi akoloytheito, kai opoy eimi ego ekei kai o diakonos o emos estai* ean tis emoi diakone timisei auton o patir.
verses.translation: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

verses.original: Νῦν ἡ ψυχή μου τετάρακται, καὶ τί εἴπω; πάτερ, σῶσόν με ἐκ τῆς ὥρας ταύτης. ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ὥραν ταύτην.
verses.translit: Nun e psyhi moy tetaraktai, kai ti eipo; pater, soson me ek tes oras taytis. alla dia touto elthon eis ten oran taytin.
verses.translation: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

verses.original: πάτερ, δόξασόν σου τὸ ὄνομα. ἦλθεν οὖν φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· Καὶ ἐδόξασα καὶ πάλιν δοξάσω.
verses.translit: pater, doxason soy to onoma. elthen oun fone ek tou ouranou* Kai edoxasa kai palin doxaso.
verses.translation: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again.

verses.original: ὁ οὖν ὄχλος ὁ ἑστὼς καὶ ἀκούσας ἔλεγεν βροντὴν γεγονέναι· ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Ἄγγελος αὐτῷ λελάληκεν.
verses.translit: o oun ohlos o estos kai akoysas elegen vronten gegonenai* alloi elegon* Aggelos auto lelaliken.
verses.translation: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it , said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸂Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν⸃· Οὐ διʼ ἐμὲ ⸂ἡ φωνὴ αὕτη⸃ γέγονεν ἀλλὰ διʼ ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen* Ou di' eme e fone auti gegonen alla di' umas.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

verses.original: νῦν κρίσις ἐστὶν τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, νῦν ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἐκβληθήσεται ἔξω·
verses.translit: nun krisis estin tou kosmoy toytoy, nun o arhon tou kosmoy toytoy ekvlithisetai exo*
verses.translation: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

verses.original: κἀγὼ ⸀ἐὰν ὑψωθῶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς, πάντας ἑλκύσω πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.
verses.translit: kago ean upsotho ek tes ges, pantas elkyso pros emayton.
verses.translation: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνῄσκειν.
verses.translit: touto de elegen simainon poio thanato emellen apothneskein.
verses.translation: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος· Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ χριστὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ πῶς ⸂λέγεις σὺ⸃ ⸀ὅτι δεῖ ὑψωθῆναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;
verses.translit: apekrithi oun auto o ohlos* Emeis ekoysamen ek tou nomoy oti o hristos menei eis ton aiona, kai pos legeis su oti dei upsothenai ton yion tou anthropoy; tis estin outos o yios tou anthropoy;
verses.translation: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον τὸ φῶς ⸂ἐν ὑμῖν⸃ ἐστιν. περιπατεῖτε ⸀ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, ἵνα μὴ σκοτία ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ, καὶ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει.
verses.translit: eipen oun autois o Iisous* Eti mikron hronon to fos en umin estin. peripateite os to fos ehete, ina me skotia umas katalave, kai o peripaton en te skotia ouk oiden pou upagei.
verses.translation: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

verses.original: ⸀ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, πιστεύετε εἰς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα υἱοὶ φωτὸς γένησθε. Ταῦτα ⸀ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἐκρύβη ἀπʼ αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: os to fos ehete, pisteyete eis to fos, ina yioi fotos genisthe. Tauta elalisen Iisous, kai apelthon ekryvi ap' auton.
verses.translation: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

verses.original: τοσαῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ σημεῖα πεποιηκότος ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν,
verses.translit: tosauta de autou simeia pepoiikotos emprosthen auton ouk episteyon eis auton,
verses.translation: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ λόγος Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν· Κύριε, τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν; καὶ ὁ βραχίων κυρίου τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη;
verses.translit: ina o logos EsaIoy tou profitoy plirothe on eipen* Kyrie, tis episteysen te akoe emon; kai o vrahion kyrioy tini apekalyfthi;
verses.translation: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἠδύναντο πιστεύειν ὅτι πάλιν εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας·
verses.translit: dia touto ouk edynanto pisteyein oti palin eipen EsaIas*
verses.translation: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

verses.original: Τετύφλωκεν αὐτῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ ⸀ἐπώρωσεν αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν, ἵνα μὴ ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ νοήσωσιν τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ ⸀στραφῶσιν, καὶ ⸀ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.
verses.translit: Tetyfloken auton tous ofthalmous kai eporosen auton ten kardian, ina me idosin tois ofthalmois kai noisosin te kardia kai strafosin, kai iasomai autoys.
verses.translation: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.original: ταῦτα εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας ⸀ὅτι εἶδεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: tauta eipen EsaIas oti eiden ten doxan autou, kai elalisen peri autou.
verses.translation: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

verses.original: ὅμως μέντοι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς Φαρισαίους οὐχ ὡμολόγουν ἵνα μὴ ἀποσυνάγωγοι γένωνται,
verses.translit: omos mentoi kai ek ton arhonton polloi episteysan eis auton, alla dia tous Farisaioys ouh omologoyn ina me aposynagogoi genontai,
verses.translation: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

verses.original: ἠγάπησαν γὰρ τὴν δόξαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων μᾶλλον ἤπερ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: egapisan gar ten doxan ton anthropon mallon eper ten doxan tou theou.
verses.translation: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἔκραξεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ πιστεύει εἰς ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸν πέμψαντά με,
verses.translit: Iisous de ekraxen kai eipen* O pisteyon eis eme ou pisteyei eis eme alla eis ton pempsanta me,
verses.translation: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ θεωρῶν ἐμὲ θεωρεῖ τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.translit: kai o theoron eme theorei ton pempsanta me.
verses.translation: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

verses.original: ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ μὴ μείνῃ.
verses.translit: ego fos eis ton kosmon elilytha, ina pas o pisteyon eis eme en te skotia me meine.
verses.translation: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τίς μου ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων καὶ μὴ ⸀φυλάξῃ, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω αὐτόν, οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον ἵνα κρίνω τὸν κόσμον ἀλλʼ ἵνα σώσω τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: kai ean tis moy akoyse ton Rimaton kai me fylaxe, ego ou krino auton, ou gar elthon ina krino ton kosmon all' ina soso ton kosmon.
verses.translation: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

verses.original: ὁ ἀθετῶν ἐμὲ καὶ μὴ λαμβάνων τὰ ῥήματά μου ἔχει τὸν κρίνοντα αὐτόν· ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησα ἐκεῖνος κρινεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ·
verses.translit: o atheton eme kai me lamvanon ta Rimata moy ehei ton krinonta auton* o logos on elalisa ekeinos krinei auton en te eshate emera*
verses.translation: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλάλησα, ἀλλʼ ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ αὐτός μοι ἐντολὴν ⸀δέδωκεν τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω.
verses.translit: oti ego ex emaytou ouk elalisa, all' o pempsas me pater autos moi entolen dedoken ti eipo kai ti laliso.
verses.translation: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

verses.original: καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιός ἐστιν. ἃ οὖν ⸂ἐγὼ λαλῶ⸃, καθὼς εἴρηκέν μοι ὁ πατήρ, οὕτως λαλῶ.
verses.translit: kai oida oti e entole autou zoe aionios estin. a oun ego lalo, kathos eiriken moi o patir, outos lalo.
verses.translation: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

verses.original: Πρὸ δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ⸀ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα ἵνα μεταβῇ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ἀγαπήσας τοὺς ἰδίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰς τέλος ἠγάπησεν αὐτούς.
verses.translit: Pro de tes eortes tou pasha eidos o Iisous oti elthen autou e ora ina metave ek tou kosmoy toytoy pros ton patera agapisas tous idioys tous en to kosmo eis telos egapisen autoys.
verses.translation: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.original: καὶ δείπνου ⸀γινομένου, τοῦ διαβόλου ἤδη βεβληκότος εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ⸂ἵνα παραδοῖ αὐτὸν Ἰούδας Σίμωνος ⸀Ἰσκαριώτου⸃,
verses.translit: kai deipnoy ginomenoy, tou diavoloy edi vevlikotos eis ten kardian ina paradoi auton Ioydas Simonos Iskariotoy,
verses.translation: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , to betray him;

verses.original: ⸀εἰδὼς ὅτι πάντα ⸀ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας, καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ὑπάγει,
verses.translit: eidos oti panta edoken auto o pater eis tas heiras, kai oti apo theou exelthen kai pros ton theon upagei,
verses.translation: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

verses.original: ἐγείρεται ἐκ τοῦ δείπνου καὶ τίθησιν τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λαβὼν λέντιον διέζωσεν ἑαυτόν·
verses.translit: egeiretai ek tou deipnoy kai tithisin ta imatia kai lavon lention diezosen eayton*
verses.translation: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

verses.original: εἶτα βάλλει ὕδωρ εἰς τὸν νιπτῆρα, καὶ ἤρξατο νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας τῶν μαθητῶν καὶ ἐκμάσσειν τῷ λεντίῳ ᾧ ἦν διεζωσμένος.
verses.translit: eita vallei udor eis ton niptera, kai erxato niptein tous podas ton mathiton kai ekmassein to lentio o en diezosmenos.
verses.translation: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

verses.original: ἔρχεται οὖν πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον. ⸀λέγει ⸀αὐτῷ· Κύριε, σύ μου νίπτεις τοὺς πόδας;
verses.translit: erhetai oun pros Simona Petron. legei auto* Kyrie, sy moy nipteis tous podas;
verses.translation: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ σὺ οὐκ οἶδας ἄρτι, γνώσῃ δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen auto* O ego poio su ouk oidas arti, gnose de meta tauta.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Πέτρος· Οὐ μὴ νίψῃς ⸂μου τοὺς πόδας⸃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἀπεκρίθη ⸂Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ⸃· Ἐὰν μὴ νίψω σε, οὐκ ἔχεις μέρος μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: legei auto Petros* Ou me nipses moy tous podas eis ton aiona. apekrithi Iisous auto* Ean me nipso se, ouk eheis meros met' emou.
verses.translation: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, μὴ τοὺς πόδας μου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν κεφαλήν.
verses.translit: legei auto Simon Petros* Kyrie, me tous podas moy monon alla kai tas heiras kai ten kefalin.
verses.translation: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ λελουμένος ⸂οὐκ ἔχει χρείαν⸃ ⸂εἰ μὴ⸃ τοὺς πόδας νίψασθαι, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν καθαρὸς ὅλος· καὶ ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε, ἀλλʼ οὐχὶ πάντες.
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* O leloymenos ouk ehei hreian ei me tous podas nipsasthai, all' estin katharos olos* kai umeis katharoi este, all' ouhi pantes.
verses.translation: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

verses.original: ᾔδει γὰρ τὸν παραδιδόντα αὐτόν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν ⸀ὅτι Οὐχὶ πάντες καθαροί ἐστε.
verses.translit: edei gar ton paradidonta auton* dia touto eipen oti Ouhi pantes katharoi este.
verses.translation: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἔνιψεν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν ⸀καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ⸂καὶ ἀνέπεσεν⸃, πάλιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γινώσκετε τί πεποίηκα ὑμῖν;
verses.translit: Ote oun enipsen tous podas auton kai elaven ta imatia autou kai anepesen, palin eipen autois* Ginoskete ti pepoiika umin;
verses.translation: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

verses.original: ὑμεῖς φωνεῖτέ με Ὁ διδάσκαλος καὶ Ὁ κύριος, καὶ καλῶς λέγετε, εἰμὶ γάρ.
verses.translit: umeis foneite me O didaskalos kai O kyrios, kai kalos legete, eimi gar.
verses.translation: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

verses.original: εἰ οὖν ἐγὼ ἔνιψα ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ διδάσκαλος, καὶ ὑμεῖς ὀφείλετε ἀλλήλων νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας·
verses.translit: ei oun ego enipsa umon tous podas o kyrios kai o didaskalos, kai umeis ofeilete allilon niptein tous podas*
verses.translation: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.original: ὑπόδειγμα γὰρ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν ἵνα καθὼς ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε.
verses.translit: upodeigma gar edoka umin ina kathos ego epoiisa umin kai umeis poiete.
verses.translation: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπόστολος μείζων τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, ouk estin doulos meizon tou kyrioy autou oude apostolos meizon tou pempsantos auton.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

verses.original: εἰ ταῦτα οἴδατε, μακάριοί ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε αὐτά.
verses.translit: ei tauta oidate, makarioi este ean poiete auta.
verses.translation: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

verses.original: οὐ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν λέγω· ἐγὼ οἶδα ⸀τίνας ἐξελεξάμην· ἀλλʼ ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ· Ὁ τρώγων ⸀μου τὸν ἄρτον ἐπῆρεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὴν πτέρναν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ou peri panton umon lego* ego oida tinas exelexamin* all' ina e grafe plirothe* O trogon moy ton arton eperen ep' eme ten pternan autou.
verses.translation: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.original: ἀπʼ ἄρτι λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι, ἵνα ⸂πιστεύσητε ὅταν γένηται⸃ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.
verses.translit: ap' arti lego umin pro tou genesthai, ina pisteysite otan genitai oti ego eimi.
verses.translation: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he .

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ λαμβάνων ⸀ἄν τινα πέμψω ἐμὲ λαμβάνει, ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ λαμβάνων λαμβάνει τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, o lamvanon an tina pempso eme lamvanei, o de eme lamvanon lamvanei ton pempsanta me.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

verses.original: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.
verses.translit: Tauta eipon o Iisous etarahthi to pneymati kai emartyrisen kai eipen* Amen amen lego umin oti eis ex umon paradosei me.
verses.translation: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.original: ⸀ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει.
verses.translit: evlepon eis alliloys oi mathitai aporoymenoi peri tinos legei.
verses.translation: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

verses.original: ⸀ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ⸀ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς·
verses.translit: en anakeimenos eis ek ton mathiton autou en to kolpo tou Iisou, on egapa o Iisous*
verses.translation: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

verses.original: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος ⸂πυθέσθαι τίς ἂν εἴη⸃ περὶ οὗ λέγει.
verses.translit: neyei oun toyto Simon Petros pythesthai tis an eii peri ou legei.
verses.translation: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

verses.original: ⸀ἀναπεσὼν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, τίς ἐστιν;
verses.translit: anapeson ekeinos outos epi to stethos tou Iisou legei auto* Kyrie, tis estin;
verses.translation: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

verses.original: ⸀ἀποκρίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ ⸀βάψω τὸ ψωμίον ⸂καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ⸃· ⸂βάψας οὖν⸃ τὸ ⸀ψωμίον δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος ⸀Ἰσκαριώτου.
verses.translit: apokrinetai o Iisous* Ekeinos estin o ego vapso to psomion kai doso auto* vapsas oun to psomion didosin Ioyda Simonos Iskariotoy.
verses.translation: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it . And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.original: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς. λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον.
verses.translit: kai meta to psomion tote eiselthen eis ekeinon o Satanas. legei oun auto o Iisous* O poieis poiison tahion.
verses.translation: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ·
verses.translit: touto de oudeis egno ton anakeimenon pros ti eipen auto*
verses.translation: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

verses.original: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν, ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον ⸀εἶχεν Ἰούδας, ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ.
verses.translit: tines gar edokoyn, epei to glossokomon eihen Ioydas, oti legei auto o Iisous* Agorason on hreian ehomen eis ten eortin, e tois ptohois ina ti do.
verses.translation: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

verses.original: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ⸂ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς⸃. ἦν δὲ νύξ.
verses.translit: lavon oun to psomion ekeinos exelthen euthys. en de nyx.
verses.translation: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

verses.original: Ὅτε ⸀οὖν ἐξῆλθεν ⸀λέγει Ἰησοῦς· Νῦν ἐδοξάσθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ·
verses.translit: Ote oun exelthen legei Iisous* Nun edoxasthi o yios tou anthropoy, kai o theos edoxasthi en auto*
verses.translation: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

verses.original: ⸂εἰ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ,⸃ καὶ ὁ θεὸς δοξάσει αὐτὸν ἐν ⸀αὑτῷ, καὶ εὐθὺς δοξάσει αὐτόν.
verses.translit: ei o theos edoxasthi en auto, kai o theos doxasei auton en auto, kai euthus doxasei auton.
verses.translation: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

verses.original: τεκνία, ἔτι μικρὸν μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι· ζητήσετέ με, καὶ καθὼς εἶπον τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ὅπου ⸂ἐγὼ ὑπάγω⸃ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν, καὶ ὑμῖν λέγω ἄρτι.
verses.translit: teknia, eti mikron meth' umon eimi* zitisete me, kai kathos eipon tois Ioydaiois oti Opoy ego upago umeis ou dynasthe elthein, kai umin lego arti.
verses.translation: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

verses.original: ἐντολὴν καινὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
verses.translit: entolen kainen didomi umin ina agapate alliloys, kathos egapisa umas ina kai umeis agapate alliloys.
verses.translation: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε, ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.
verses.translit: en toyto gnosontai pantes oti emoi mathitai este, ean agapin ehite en allilois.
verses.translation: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, ποῦ ὑπάγεις; ⸀ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ὅπου ὑπάγω οὐ δύνασαί μοι νῦν ἀκολουθῆσαι, ⸂ἀκολουθήσεις δὲ ὕστερον⸃.
verses.translit: Legei auto Simon Petros* Kyrie, pou upageis; apekrithi Iisous* Opoy upago ou dynasai moi nun akoloythesai, akoloythiseis de usteron.
verses.translation: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Πέτρος· Κύριε, διὰ τί οὐ δύναμαί σοι ⸀ἀκολουθῆσαι ἄρτι; τὴν ψυχήν μου ὑπὲρ σοῦ θήσω.
verses.translit: legei auto o Petros* Kyrie, dia ti ou dynamai soi akoloythesai arti; ten psyhin moy uper sou thiso.
verses.translation: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

verses.original: ⸀ἀποκρίνεται Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ θήσεις; ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἀλέκτωρ φωνήσῃ ἕως οὗ ⸀ἀρνήσῃ με τρίς.
verses.translit: apokrinetai Iisous* Ten psyhin soy uper emou thiseis; amen amen lego soi, ou me alektor fonise eos ou arnise me tris.
verses.translation: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

verses.original: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία· πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν θεόν, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε.
verses.translit: Me tarassestho umon e kardia* pisteyete eis ton theon, kai eis eme pisteyete.
verses.translation: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

verses.original: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν· εἰ δὲ μή, εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν ⸀ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: en te oikia tou patros moy monai pollai eisin* ei de mi, eipon an umin oti poreyomai etoimasai topon umin*
verses.translation: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so , I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ ⸀καὶ ἑτοιμάσω ⸂τόπον ὑμῖν⸃, πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε.
verses.translit: kai ean poreytho kai etoimaso topon umin, palin erhomai kai paralimpsomai umas pros emayton, ina opoy eimi ego kai umeis ete.
verses.translation: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε ⸂τὴν ὁδόν⸃.
verses.translit: kai opoy ego upago oidate ten odon.
verses.translation: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς· Κύριε, οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις· ⸀πῶς ⸂δυνάμεθα τὴν ὁδὸν εἰδέναι⸃;
verses.translit: legei auto Thomas* Kyrie, ouk oidamen pou upageis* pos dynametha ten odon eidenai?
verses.translation: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή· οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν πατέρα εἰ μὴ διʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* Ego eimi e odos kai e alitheia kai e zoi* oudeis erhetai pros ton patera ei me di' emou.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

verses.original: εἰ ⸀ἐγνώκειτέ με, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ⸂ἂν ᾔδειτε⸃· ⸀ἀπʼ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε ⸀αὐτόν.
verses.translit: ei egnokeite me, kai ton patera moy an edeite* ap' arti ginoskete auton kai eorakate auton.
verses.translation: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος· Κύριε, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: Legei auto Filippos* Kyrie, deixon emin ton patera, kai arkei emin.
verses.translation: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ⸂Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ⸃ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με, Φίλιππε; ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα· ⸀πῶς σὺ λέγεις· Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα;
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* Tosoyto hrono meth' umon eimi kai ouk egnokas me, Filippe; o eorakos eme eoraken ton patera* pos su legeis* Deixon emin ton patera;
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father?

verses.original: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν; τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ ⸀λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ, ὁ δὲ ⸀πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ ⸀μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα ⸀αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ou pisteyeis oti ego en to patri kai o pater en emoi estin; ta Rimata a ego lego umin ap' emaytou ou lalo, o de pater en emoi menon poiei ta erga autou.
verses.translation: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

verses.original: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί· εἰ δὲ μή, διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ ⸀πιστεύετε.
verses.translit: pisteyete moi oti ego en to patri kai o pater en emoi* ei de mi, dia ta erga auta pisteyete.
verses.translation: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει, καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει, ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα πορεύομαι·
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin, o pisteyon eis eme ta erga a ego poio kakeinos poiisei, kai meizona toyton poiisei, oti ego pros ton patera poreyomai*
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

verses.original: καὶ ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ·
verses.translit: kai o ti an aitisite en to onomati moy touto poiiso, ina doxasthe o pater en to yio*
verses.translation: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.original: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ ⸀με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ⸀ἐγὼ ποιήσω.
verses.translit: ean ti aitisite me en to onomati moy ego poiiso.
verses.translation: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με, τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς ⸀τηρήσετε·
verses.translit: Ean agapate me, tas entolas tas emas tirisete*
verses.translation: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

verses.original: κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ⸀ᾖ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν ⸀αἰῶνα,
verses.translit: kago erotiso ton patera kai allon parakliton dosei umin ina e meth' umon eis ton aiona,
verses.translation: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν, ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ ⸀γινώσκει· ⸀ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό, ὅτι παρʼ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ⸀ἔσται.
verses.translit: to pneuma tes alitheias, o o kosmos ou dynatai lavein, oti ou theorei auto oude ginoskei* umeis ginoskete auto, oti par' umin menei kai en umin estai.
verses.translation: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς, ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: Ouk afiso umas orfanoys, erhomai pros umas.
verses.translation: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

verses.original: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ, ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με, ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ⸀ζήσετε.
verses.translit: eti mikron kai o kosmos me ouketi theorei, umeis de theoreite me, oti ego zo kai umeis zisete.
verses.translation: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ⸂γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς⸃ ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: en ekeine te emera gnosesthe umeis oti ego en to patri moy kai umeis en emoi kago en umin.
verses.translation: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με· ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν.
verses.translit: o ehon tas entolas moy kai tiron autas ekeinos estin o agapon me* o de agapon me agapithisetai upo tou patros moy, kago agapiso auton kai emfaniso auto emayton.
verses.translation: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας, οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης· Κύριε, ⸀τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ;
verses.translit: legei auto Ioydas, ouh o Iskariotis* Kyrie, ti gegonen oti emin melleis emfanizein seayton kai ouhi to kosmo;
verses.translation: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρʼ αὐτῷ ⸀ποιησόμεθα.
verses.translit: apekrithi Iisous kai eipen auto* Ean tis agapa me ton logon moy tirisei, kai o patir moy agapisei auton, kai pros auton eleysometha kai monen par' auto poiisometha.
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

verses.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ· καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με πατρός.
verses.translit: o me agapon me tous logoys moy ou tirei* kai o logos on akoyete ouk estin emos alla tou pempsantos me patros.
verses.translation: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρʼ ὑμῖν μένων·
verses.translit: Tauta lelalika umin par' umin menon*
verses.translation: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ παράκλητος, τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ⸀ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: o de paraklitos, to pneuma to agion o pempsei o pater en to onomati moy, ekeinos umas didaxei panta kai upomnisei umas panta a eipon umin.
verses.translation: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

verses.original: εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν· οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν. μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω.
verses.translit: eirinin afiimi umin, eirinin ten emen didomi umin* ou kathos o kosmos didosin ego didomi umin. me tarassestho umon e kardia mide deiliato.
verses.translation: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

verses.original: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν· Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς. εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν, ⸀ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ὅτι ὁ ⸀πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν.
verses.translit: ekoysate oti ego eipon umin* Upago kai erhomai pros umas. ei egapate me eharite an, oti poreyomai pros ton patera, oti o pater meizon moy estin.
verses.translation: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι, ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε.
verses.translit: kai nun eirika umin prin genesthai, ina otan genitai pisteysite.
verses.translation: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

verses.original: οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθʼ ὑμῶν, ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων· καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν,
verses.translit: ouketi polla laliso meth' umon, erhetai gar o tou kosmoy arhon* kai en emoi ouk ehei ouden,
verses.translation: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ καθὼς ⸀ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ πατὴρ οὕτως ποιῶ. Ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν.
verses.translit: all' ina gno o kosmos oti agapo ton patera, kai kathos eneteilato moi o pater outos poio. Egeiresthe, agomen enteuthen.
verses.translation: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀληθινή, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν·
verses.translit: Ego eimi e ampelos e alithini, kai o patir moy o georgos estin*
verses.translation: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

verses.original: πᾶν κλῆμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μὴ φέρον καρπὸν αἴρει αὐτό, καὶ πᾶν τὸ καρπὸν φέρον καθαίρει αὐτὸ ἵνα ⸂καρπὸν πλείονα⸃ φέρῃ.
verses.translit: pan klema en emoi me feron karpon airei auto, kai pan to karpon feron kathairei auto ina karpon pleiona fere.
verses.translation: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

verses.original: ἤδη ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε διὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν λελάληκα ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: edi umeis katharoi este dia ton logon on lelalika umin*
verses.translation: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

verses.original: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί, κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν. καθὼς τὸ κλῆμα οὐ δύναται καρπὸν φέρειν ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μὴ ⸀μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ, οὕτως οὐδὲ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ἐμοὶ ⸀μένητε.
verses.translit: meinate en emoi, kago en umin. kathos to klema ou dynatai karpon ferein af' eaytou ean me mene en te ampelo, outos oude umeis ean me en emoi menite.
verses.translation: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος, ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα. ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ οὗτος φέρει καρπὸν πολύν, ὅτι χωρὶς ἐμοῦ οὐ δύνασθε ποιεῖν οὐδέν.
verses.translit: ego eimi e ampelos, umeis ta klimata. o menon en emoi kago en auto outos ferei karpon polyn, oti horis emou ou dynasthe poiein ouden.
verses.translation: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

verses.original: ἐὰν μή τις ⸀μένῃ ἐν ἐμοί, ἐβλήθη ἔξω ὡς τὸ κλῆμα καὶ ἐξηράνθη, καὶ συνάγουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ εἰς τὸ πῦρ βάλλουσιν καὶ καίεται.
verses.translit: ean mi tis mene en emoi, evlithi exo os to klema kai exiranthi, kai synagoysin auta kai eis to pur valloysin kai kaietai.
verses.translation: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.original: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ, ὃ ἐὰν θέλητε ⸀αἰτήσασθε καὶ γενήσεται ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: ean meinite en emoi kai ta Rimata moy en umin meine, o ean thelite aitisasthe kai genisetai umin*
verses.translation: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐδοξάσθη ὁ πατήρ μου ἵνα καρπὸν πολὺν φέρητε καὶ ⸀γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί.
verses.translit: en toyto edoxasthi o patir moy ina karpon polun ferite kai genisthe emoi mathitai.
verses.translation: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

verses.original: καθὼς ἠγάπησέν με ὁ πατήρ, κἀγὼ ⸂ὑμᾶς ἠγάπησα⸃, μείνατε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐμῇ.
verses.translit: kathos egapisen me o patir, kago umas egapisa, meinate en te agape te eme.
verses.translation: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

verses.original: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου, καθὼς ἐγὼ ⸂τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ πατρός μου⸃ τετήρηκα καὶ μένω αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.translit: ean tas entolas moy tirisite, meneite en te agape moy, kathos ego tas entolas tou patros moy tetirika kai meno autou en te agape.
verses.translation: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

verses.original: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ ἐν ὑμῖν ⸀ᾖ καὶ ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν πληρωθῇ.
verses.translit: tauta lelalika umin ina e hara e eme en umin e kai e hara umon plirothe.
verses.translation: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

verses.original: Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ ἐμὴ ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς·
verses.translit: Auti estin e entole e eme ina agapate alliloys kathos egapisa umas*
verses.translation: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

verses.original: μείζονα ταύτης ἀγάπην οὐδεὶς ἔχει, ἵνα τις τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ θῇ ὑπὲρ τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: meizona taytis agapin oudeis ehei, ina tis ten psyhen autou the uper ton filon autou.
verses.translation: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς φίλοι μού ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε ⸀ἃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: umeis filoi moy este ean poiete a ego entellomai umin.
verses.translation: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

verses.original: οὐκέτι ⸂λέγω ὑμᾶς⸃ δούλους, ὅτι ὁ δοῦλος οὐκ οἶδεν τί ποιεῖ αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος· ὑμᾶς δὲ εἴρηκα φίλους, ὅτι πάντα ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου ἐγνώρισα ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ouketi lego umas doyloys, oti o doulos ouk oiden ti poiei autou o kyrios* umas de eirika filoys, oti panta a ekoysa para tou patros moy egnorisa umin.
verses.translation: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

verses.original: οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἐξελέξασθε, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἔθηκα ὑμᾶς ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑπάγητε καὶ καρπὸν φέρητε καὶ ὁ καρπὸς ὑμῶν μένῃ, ἵνα ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δῷ ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ouh umeis me exelexasthe, all' ego exelexamin umas, kai ethika umas ina umeis upagite kai karpon ferite kai o karpos umon mene, ina o ti an aitisite ton patera en to onomati moy do umin.
verses.translation: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

verses.original: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
verses.translit: tauta entellomai umin ina agapate alliloys.
verses.translation: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

verses.original: Εἰ ὁ κόσμος ὑμᾶς μισεῖ, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐμὲ πρῶτον ⸀ὑμῶν μεμίσηκεν.
verses.translit: Ei o kosmos umas misei, ginoskete oti eme proton umon memisiken.
verses.translation: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

verses.original: εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἦτε, ὁ κόσμος ἂν τὸ ἴδιον ἐφίλει· ὅτι δὲ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ ἐστέ, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου, διὰ τοῦτο μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος.
verses.translit: ei ek tou kosmoy ete, o kosmos an to idion efilei* oti de ek tou kosmoy ouk este, all' ego exelexamin umas ek tou kosmoy, dia touto misei umas o kosmos.
verses.translation: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

verses.original: μνημονεύετε τοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν· Οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ· εἰ ἐμὲ ἐδίωξαν, καὶ ὑμᾶς διώξουσιν· εἰ τὸν λόγον μου ἐτήρησαν, καὶ τὸν ὑμέτερον τηρήσουσιν.
verses.translit: mnimoneyete tou logoy ou ego eipon umin* Ouk estin doulos meizon tou kyrioy autou* ei eme edioxan, kai umas dioxoysin* ei ton logon moy etirisan, kai ton umeteron tirisoysin.
verses.translation: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα πάντα ποιήσουσιν ⸂εἰς ὑμᾶς⸃ διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.translit: alla tauta panta poiisoysin eis umas dia to onoma moy, oti ouk oidasin ton pempsanta me.
verses.translation: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

verses.original: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ⸀εἴχοσαν· νῦν δὲ πρόφασιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: ei me elthon kai elalisa autois, amartian ouk eihosan* nun de profasin ouk ehoysin peri tes amartias auton.
verses.translation: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

verses.original: ὁ ἐμὲ μισῶν καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου μισεῖ.
verses.translit: o eme mison kai ton patera moy misei.
verses.translation: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

verses.original: εἰ τὰ ἔργα μὴ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἃ οὐδεὶς ἄλλος ⸀ἐποίησεν, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ⸀εἴχοσαν· νῦν δὲ καὶ ἑωράκασιν καὶ μεμισήκασιν καὶ ἐμὲ καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου.
verses.translit: ei ta erga me epoiisa en autois a oudeis allos epoiisen, amartian ouk eihosan* nun de kai eorakasin kai memisikasin kai eme kai ton patera moy.
verses.translation: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὁ ⸂ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτῶν γεγραμμένος⸃ ὅτι Ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν.
verses.translit: all' ina plirothe o logos o en to nomo auton gegrammenos oti Emisisan me dorean.
verses.translation: But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

verses.original: ⸀Ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ παράκλητος ὃν ἐγὼ πέμψω ὑμῖν παρὰ τοῦ πατρός, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐκπορεύεται, ἐκεῖνος μαρτυρήσει περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.translit: Otan elthe o paraklitos on ego pempso umin para tou patros, to pneuma tes alitheias o para tou patros ekporeyetai, ekeinos martyrisei peri emou*
verses.translation: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς δὲ μαρτυρεῖτε, ὅτι ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστε.
verses.translit: kai umeis de martyreite, oti ap' arhes met' emou este.
verses.translation: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.
verses.translit: Tauta lelalika umin ina me skandalisthete.
verses.translation: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

verses.original: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.translit: aposynagogoys poiisoysin umas* all' erhetai ora ina pas o apokteinas umas doxe latreian prosferein to theo.
verses.translation: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.
verses.translit: kai tauta poiisoysin oti ouk egnosan ton patera oude eme.
verses.translation: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα ⸀αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε ⸁αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. Ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἤμην.
verses.translit: alla tauta lelalika umin ina otan elthe e ora auton mnimoneyite auton oti ego eipon umin. Tauta de umin ex arhes ouk eipon, oti meth' umon emin.
verses.translation: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

verses.original: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με· Ποῦ ὑπάγεις;
verses.translit: nun de upago pros ton pempsanta me kai oudeis ex umon erota me* Pou upageis;
verses.translation: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.
verses.translit: all' oti tauta lelalika umin e lypi pepliroken umon ten kardian.
verses.translation: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

verses.original: ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν ⸀γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ παράκλητος ⸂οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ⸃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.translit: all' ego ten alitheian lego umin, symferei umin ina ego apeltho. ean gar me apeltho, o paraklitos ou me elthe pros umas* ean de poreytho, pempso auton pros umas.
verses.translation: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως·
verses.translit: kai elthon ekeinos elegxei ton kosmon peri amartias kai peri dikaiosynis kai peri kriseos*
verses.translation: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

verses.original: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ·
verses.translit: peri amartias men, oti ou pisteyoysin eis eme*
verses.translation: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

verses.original: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με·
verses.translit: peri dikaiosynis de, oti pros ton patera upago kai ouketi theoreite me*
verses.translation: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

verses.original: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.
verses.translit: peri de kriseos, oti o arhon tou kosmoy toytoy kekritai.
verses.translation: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

verses.original: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ⸂ὑμῖν λέγειν⸃, ἀλλʼ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι·
verses.translit: Eti polla eho umin legein, all' ou dynasthe vastazein arti*
verses.translation: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ⸂ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάσῃ⸃, οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὅσα ⸀ἀκούσει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: otan de elthe ekeinos, to pneuma tes alitheias, odigisei umas en te alitheia pase, ou gar lalisei af' eaytou, all' osa akoysei lalisei, kai ta erhomena anaggelei umin.
verses.translation: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: ekeinos eme doxasei, oti ek tou emou limpsetai kai anaggelei umin.
verses.translation: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.original: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: panta osa ehei o pater ema estin* dia touto eipon oti ek tou emou lamvanei kai anaggelei umin.
verses.translation: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.original: Μικρὸν καὶ ⸀οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ ⸀με.
verses.translit: Mikron kai ouketi theoreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me.
verses.translation: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

verses.original: εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί· ⸀Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα;
verses.translit: eipan oun ek ton mathiton autou pros alliloys* Ti estin touto o legei emin* Mikron kai ou theoreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me; kai* Oti upago pros ton patera;
verses.translation: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν· ⸂Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο⸃ ὃ ⸀λέγει μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ.
verses.translit: elegon oun* Ti estin touto o legei mikron; ouk oidamen ti lalei.
verses.translation: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

verses.original: ⸀ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετʼ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;
verses.translit: egno Iisous oti ethelon auton erotan, kai eipen autois* Peri toytoy ziteite met' allilon oti eipon* Mikron kai ou theoreite me, kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me;
verses.translation: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ⸀ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλʼ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.
verses.translit: amen amen lego umin oti klaysete kai thrinisete umeis, o de kosmos harisetai* umeis lypithisesthe, all' e lypi umon eis haran genisetai.
verses.translation: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

verses.original: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: e gyne otan tikte lypin ehei, oti elthen e ora autes* otan de gennise to paidion, ouketi mnimoneyei tes thlipseos dia ten haran oti egennithi anthropos eis ton kosmon.
verses.translation: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ⸂νῦν μὲν λύπην⸃ ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς ⸀αἴρει ἀφʼ ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: kai umeis oun nun men lypin ehete* palin de opsomai umas, kai harisetai umon e kardia, kai ten haran umon oudeis airei af' umon.
verses.translation: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν· ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ⸂ἄν τι⸃ αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα ⸂δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου⸃.
verses.translit: kai en ekeine te emera eme ouk erotisete ouden* amen amen lego umin, an ti aitisite ton patera dosei umin en to onomati moy.
verses.translation: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

verses.original: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου· αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.
verses.translit: eos arti ouk etisate ouden en to onomati moy* aiteite kai limpsesthe, ina e hara umon e pepliromeni.
verses.translation: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν· ⸀ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ⸀ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: Tauta en paroimiais lelalika umin* erhetai ora ote ouketi en paroimiais laliso umin alla parrisia peri tou patros apaggelo umin.
verses.translation: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν·
verses.translit: en ekeine te emera en to onomati moy aitisesthe, kai ou lego umin oti ego erotiso ton patera peri umon*
verses.translation: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

verses.original: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον.
verses.translit: autos gar o pater filei umas, oti umeis eme pefilikate kai pepisteykate oti ego para tou theou exelthon.
verses.translation: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον ⸀ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον· πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
verses.translit: exelthon ek tou patros kai elilytha eis ton kosmon* palin afiimi ton kosmon kai poreyomai pros ton patera.
verses.translation: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

verses.original: ⸀Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Ἴδε νῦν ⸀ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.
verses.translit: Legoysin oi mathitai autou* Ide nun en parrisia laleis, kai paroimian oudemian legeis.
verses.translation: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

verses.original: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ· ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.
verses.translit: nun oidamen oti oidas panta kai ou hreian eheis ina tis se erota* en toyto pisteyomen oti apo theou exelthes.
verses.translation: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρτι πιστεύετε;
verses.translit: apekrithi autois Iisous* Arti pisteyete;
verses.translation: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα ⸀καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε· καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.
verses.translit: idou erhetai ora kai elilythen ina skorpisthete ekastos eis ta idia kame monon afete* kai ouk eimi monos, oti o pater met' emou estin.
verses.translation: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

verses.original: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε· ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε, ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.
verses.translit: tauta lelalika umin ina en emoi eirinin ehite* en to kosmo thlipsin ehete, alla tharseite, ego nenikika ton kosmon.
verses.translation: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ⸀ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ⸂ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν⸃· Πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν, ⸀ἵνα ὁ ⸀υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,
verses.translit: Tauta elalisen Iisous, kai eparas tous ofthalmous autou eis ton ouranon eipen* Pater, elilythen e ora* doxason soy ton yion, ina o yios doxase se,
verses.translation: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

verses.original: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ ⸀δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: kathos edokas auto exoysian pasis sarkos, ina pan o dedokas auto dose autois zoen aionion.
verses.translation: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

verses.original: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσι σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.
verses.translit: auti de estin e aionios zoe ina ginoskosi se ton monon alithinon theon kai on apesteilas Iisoun Hriston.
verses.translation: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

verses.original: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον ⸀τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω·
verses.translit: ego se edoxasa epi tes ges, to ergon teleiosas o dedokas moi ina poiiso*
verses.translation: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.
verses.translit: kai nun doxason me sy, pater, para seayto te doxe e eihon pro tou ton kosmon einai para soi.
verses.translation: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

verses.original: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ⸀ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ⸁ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν.
verses.translit: Efanerosa soy to onoma tois anthropois ous edokas moi ek tou kosmoy. soi esan kamoi autous edokas, kai ton logon soy tetirikan.
verses.translation: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

verses.original: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα ⸀δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ ⸀εἰσιν·
verses.translit: nun egnokan oti panta osa dedokas moi para sou eisin*
verses.translation: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

verses.original: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ⸀ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.
verses.translit: oti ta Rimata a edokas moi dedoka autois, kai autoi elavon kai egnosan alithos oti para sou exelthon, kai episteysan oti sy me apesteilas.
verses.translation: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
